Dialog: Yep, I'm sticking to my resolution and turning over a new leaf. Fifteen whole minutes and I haven't thought of Phineas and Ferb. (her eye starts twitching) How they make those things. You know, those big, like, dangerous things they make...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Good, good, good, good, good, good, good, good, good, good. Perfect! You guys built your sky-high mega-ride thingy. I just wanted to double-check, and this time, I'm not gonna call Mom. I'm gonna (starts walking backwards away from them) go get her. Ciao!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No. If it can tell me when it will take the boys' stuff away, I can get Mom to show up right before so she can bust once and for all! O Great Mysterious Force, when will thou takest away what the boys hath built?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's not fun, it's relaxing. Which means it's enjoyable, which means it's fun. Grown-up fun. You wouldn't understand. Besides, Le Rub de Scrub Spa is very exclusive. You can't even get in unless you know someone.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's just... Jeremy looked like he was having a really good time here. And suddenly it seemed creepy and obsessive that I came all this way. What if he doesn't wanna see me? Or came to Paris to get away from me?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stace, the thing with boys is I just don't get them. You think they're saying one thing, but then you don't know if they really mean something else. They're like those Egyptian drawings that no one understands.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Obvious technical infractions. Go away. The player who committed the infraction is no give me that. No Ginger, I'm busy. I said give me that back. If you don't give that back to me right now, Candace, gotta go.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mr. Cutie-Patootie, I finally found— (Notices Perry, then nudges him out from her room with her foot) Get away from him! I don't want your blandness to rub off. (Picks up Dennis, then slams the door) Aw, poor Mr. Cutie-Patootie. Don't mind him. Once I'm done making you over, you're going to be the new alpha pet!

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's from Jeremy! He sent me a picture. (looks at picture) Aw, look at his cute, little wiener hat. Let's send him a picture of me. Make sure you get my good side. How's the lighting? (Stacy takes the picture) Wait, you took it while I was still talking!

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's obviously some big, stupid dress-up game they're playing with their little loser friends. Now, if my research is correct, the way to defeat a superhero is to come at him through what's important to him. (She holds up a picture of the boys and Linda before laughing maniacally)

Name: Candace
Dialog: My Bango-Ru. They're these adorable Japanese characters that are so in right now. Like in a kitschy way. The guitarist for The Bettys has one painted on her guitar. Stacy and I designed our own dolls online.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, it's been four days. (Rolls her chair to a picture referencing Cinderella. The faces are replaced with Candace and Jeremy's faces) I'm not expecting Prince Charming to bring me a glass slipper or anything, but-but a phone call would be nice. (Phone beeping) Hold on, I've got another call. (Gasps) (Holds up the phone, showing a heart with Jeremy's face in it) It's him! Call you back! Bye! (Phone beeps) Hello?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sighs) It's okay. Earlier this morning, I wouldn't have believed me either. In fact, I was even mocking my... (gets an idea) brothers! That's it! They'll vindicate me! They're out there right now getting proof that Nosey is real!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on the phone) That's what going steady is, Stacy! Jeremy and I aren't really engaged. But we're totally engaged to be engaged to be engaged. And by the way, that's on a "need-to-know" basis. (Scoffs) Why would Jeremy need to know?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I just thought it was the perfect day to show some Christmas spirit. Like when you were young and wrote letters to Santa... (Out the window, Phineas and Ferb are seen lifting some of their things to thank Santa.) Would you keep that lame junk away from my window!? (to Jeremy) I'm sorry, what was I saying?

Name: Candace
Dialog: That feeling you have right now: that's how I feel every single day when you don't believe me about what Phineas and Ferb are doing! Now that you finally understand, would you come with me to the backyard?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, it's great. Finally, somebody appreciates my ideas. Only, they keep bringing me crumbs and grasshopper legs. I could really go for a salad. (an ant goes to make a salad) And you think, they'd have a fancy queen dress, or something. (another ant goes to make a dress)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Just wait until Mom hears about... Then again, you guys always seem to make everything disappear before Mom gets home. But if I take the evidence to her at the Bowl-A-Rama, then she'll have to believe me! (She daydreams)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, puh-leez. I'm all the equipment you'll ever need. I mean, hello, let us not forget that I wrestled a ferocious alligator. (Unbeknownst to her, a giant crocodile appears behind her.) A scrappy little crocodile is nothing for a pro like me. (to the crocodile behind her) I'n' that right? (Her eyes pop in sudden realization)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah yeah, real funny. This is the official rutabaga regalia for the 100th Running of the Chinchillas from Danville to Badgertown. By wearing this, it'll entice the chinchillas to follow me, the Princess!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: (deep voice) What are you two- (coughs, normal voice) -doing here? Never mind, I'll deal with you later. (walks up to Phineas and Ferb) You two! I've been spending all these years trying to keep my brothers safe, and suddenly their faces are all over the Doofen Channel!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hah! You call that a beach? This is WAY below your usual standard. This isn't even worth a call to Mom. You know, if you guys ever want to be popular, you're gonna have to stop playing in sandboxes. (Gets hit by a beach ball) Hey!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not officially... He's never even called me his girlfriend. We've never even kissed! That means Jeremy is single, in Paris, and surrounded by French girls. I'm no fool, Stacy, I've seen the oil paintings

Name: Past Candace
Dialog: Mom and dad's antique store.. . Yes, it's still here! (the door opens automatically) Ooh, future. Mom!! It's me, Candace from the past! I came here in a time machine that Phineas and Ferb borrowed from the museum. You gotta bust them!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, cool, my old tiara. Ooh, sparkly! (picks up a videocassette) Hey, I don't remember this. Hmm. (reads) "For: Future Candace!" Hey, wait a minute! I'm Future Candace! There's gotta be a machine around here that still plays these things.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't care how buff he is. Me, hang out with one of your friends? Puh-leeze. Now run along before I take my sandwich back. And if you even think about trying something funny today, you're gonna get it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: See, Jeremy only calls me "Candace," and nothing else. When a guy makes you his girlfriend, he comes up with a nickname for you. A pet name like, "baby," "honey," "Peg-Leg Pete!" His own personal stamp!

Name: Candace
Dialog: MOM! MOM! Phineas and Ferb are making a giant tape dispenser, but it's also a faucet, and a rowboat, and a baseball hat, and a lightbulb, and a gingerbread man with a fist for a head, and a pig face --

Name: Candace
Dialog: So at this point I can grab Mom at her hair appointment and bring her over to where I think the boys are heading. I'm calculating they'll go by that weird looking building downtown, at exactly 4.59 pm.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's so wrong in so many ways, I don't even know where to start! An egg is like a little baby. It needs a living, breathing mother. It needs... Hold on one second. (She runs into the house, then closes the back door. After another pause, she kicks it open with a foot.; now wearing her "mom" suit...aka a platypus suit) Okay, let's do this thing for real!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Of course we need to know how deep it is, so we know how scared we should be. We can use this grappling hook and rope to find out. (throws it into the pit) One...Two...Three. (The rope hits the bottom) You see? Now we know that it's three seconds deep.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (In a dream) But, your honor, how could I have robbed that bank if I was already wearing the prison jumpsuit? It just doesn't make any-- (She gasps and wakes up to the sound of Buford humming) Somehow I want to finish that dream to find out if I'm guilty or not. (She walks to the window, to see Buford in the backyard, humming and tying his shoes) What?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, just breathe and relax. (Sighs) Let's try this again. (She picks up the phone.) Hi. Uh, Linda Flynn, please. But if she's too busy, uh, then maybe there's someone else who can deliver her a message. Maybe someone in their teens!

Name: Candace
Dialog: When Mom and Dad left me in charge, I never took into account that we might not make it back at all! And now we're stranded, and now I'll never get my kiss from Jeremy! (She sobs and falls to her knees) It's the end of romance! Aaagh! (She curls into a ball on the ground)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh, Mrs. Johnson, as much as I hate to admit it, Suzy's not lying. Phineas and Ferb made a ray that makes me weightless. I might as well show you I couldn't embarrass myself more than I already have.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, it's still here. Oh, come on, Mom! We're really coming down to the wire on this one. (Door closes) Mom! (She runs away then runs back) Oh, great and magical being who maketh all things magically vanish before Mom sees them, knock it off!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (after a pause, speaking to Stacy on her video phone) So, he was like totally checking me out when little Miss Pants walks in front of me. Yeah, yeah! So I was like "Uh, hello?" and so she was like "Oh no, you di-in't!" and I was like "Oh yes, I di-id!"

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, sorry, Stace. I completely forgot I was on the phone with you. Okay, okay, okay. Okay, in the whole world, maybe one or two have in worse, but definitely in Danville, no one has it worse than me!

Name: Candace
Dialog: A late entry. Okay, Mom, I've been dragged all over town by Phineas and Ferb's Mega Bounce House, which you'll probably never see, but the worst part is, I didn't even get my Tiny Cowboy bobble head!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let's definitely eat here. But no way are we waiting in this line. I practically own the place. (To other people in line) Come on! Outta my way, people! VIP coming through! (To Buford) All right, Buford, make with the rope and let us in.

Name: Candace
Dialog: To bust or not to bust. Eh, they're not my brothers, so I'm not sure it'd even count. But maybe if Mom sees this, it'll lend a little credence to all the other things I told her about. Yes! (She suddenly is holding two pairs of binoculars.) To bust!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, fine! Okay, if pictures won't work, I'll just take you to Mom myself! I know we have an old stroller around here somewhere. (Candace finds a stroller and straps in Phineas and Ferb and they fall asleep) That's it, go right to sleep. You'll be busted in just a little bit.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I'm gonna buy Jeremy a gift. It's the anniversary of the very first time Jeremy and I went to Slushy Burger. He spilled a cheese dog on me and mustard got all over the place. He was so sweet.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I just wanna do something really special to show Jeremy how much I care. Something way over the top! Something that defies the laws of physics and exceeds the boundaries of the imagination — (realizes what she's talking about) Oh no.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Brother? Busted? I just realized. I, like so many other elected officials, have forgotten the very promises I made that got me into office in the first place! That's it! I'm gonna bust my brothers!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh, I'm getting outta here. Ridiculous dungeon crawl. Dumb arrows. Stupid traps. Buncha nerdy stuff. Shards and whatever, blah, blah, blah. "Stumbleberry Finkbat". Can't wait to bust all you guys!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, I get it. Big lesson. Yeah, well, I guess I learned that it wouldn't be hard to ask Jeremy out if he was growing out of the back of my head. Now you find us some fuel, and let's get outta here.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, my gosh, you guys. That was awesome. Guys? Uh, guys? (Sees they have left the couch) Wow, it's tomorrow already. I gotta find those guys and tell them how it ended. Guys, guys, guys, ugh-- (Candace runs into Linda, who's carrying a laundry basket) Sorry, Mom. Have you seen the boys?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What is wrong with you two? Can't you think of something normal to do like making a lemonade stand or picking your nose or something? (Ferb pulls out device) That better not be a nose picking machine! (Ferb puts it down) Yeah, that's right.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I know it sounds crazy, Jeremy, but I saw it, I really did! I mean, not the times when I saw it and it wasn't it, but this last time, when I saw it and it was it! You believe me, don't you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, twelve o'clock. Let's get this over with. (Puts on her goggles.) Perry! Oh, there you are, Perry. Oh! And you're filthy!  This has got to be the highlight of your week, right? Y'know, cuz platypuses don't do much.

Name: Candace
Dialog: There they go again with their machine mocking me... (imitating Phineas with her hand) "Oh, hi, I'm Phineas! Ferb and I are building something really bust-worthy!" (Her other hand as her hair on it as she talks in her own voice in this...weird hand puppet show) "Yeah, like what? Like a submarine that'll go into my esophagus?"

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's it. I'm calling Mom and making her tell the boys to let us in. (On phone, to Linda) Mom, Phineas and Ferb have made an exclusive restaurant in the yard and you've got to tell them to tell Buford to let us in!

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, Mrs. Johnson, it's so great to talk to each other like adults. (Suzy crawls under the table, and pulls out the wrench weighing candace down) Just me and you talking all adulty and stuff, and (Candace notices her leg has floated up) WHOA! (She giggles nervously before floating up entirely, just managing to hold onto the table) Ahh! Just doin' a little yoga stretch to help this digestion, yep. Heh.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And thank you to you, Candace, for being so good at being so laid-back, and not caring about all the whatever the boys are doing right now. Whatever it is they're doing. Flying through the air.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, I've been spending all my time worrying about Phineas and Ferb. I used to have other things to worry about. Like... (dramatically) What? Jeremy's going to be there?! I just need to broaden my anxieties.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (taking Dad's phone) And it opens tomorrow. (gasps) I bet Sweetwater will go see it and say she read the book. And if you do something like triangulate her movements against the movie schedule, you could bust her no prob.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (getting Linda out of her chair) Yes,-and-you've-got-errands-to-run-'cause-they're-not-gonna-run-themselves.-They-never-do.-They-never-do.(starts pushing Linda out of the house) Better-get-a-move-on-if-you're-gonna-be-back-in-an-hour-and-twenty-seven-minutes.-Bye!

Name: Young Candace
Dialog: (on video) Thith ith Candathe Flynn. I'm five yearth old and it wath an awethome thummer! But I didn't get to do everything I wanted. Tho I made a litht of thingth I want Future Candathe to take care of.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And that is why I wear white shoes after Labor Day. And I.. (Sees Phineas and Ferb's invention) Oh, I knew it. Phineas and Ferb. Not very impressive, but suspicious. Stacy, I.. I got to go. Oh, and Happy Birthday! Mom! Mom! Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, really, Stacy? Well, they're not gonna bust themselves! Oh, great, a sale. Now guess who's gonna have to go in there and try stuff on? Call ya later, Stace. (hangs up and walks in) Since I have to do everything! (gasps)

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? On Street Fair day? Haha! No way, sister! I'll be there, and I'll be there early. Ah-haha. Yeah. Alone. Okay? Okay. (She hangs up) Oh crud. Make that molecular whatever and meet me at the coffee shop!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I'm no help to you there. Talk to you later, Stace. Good luck. (hangs up and looks at the magazine again) I wish I knew a girl like this so that I could hang out and absorb her coolness. (She puts the magazine down to see Vanessa making the same pose as the model in the magazine.) (gasps) Vanessa! Hey, Vanessa! Vanessa! Hey! Hey!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (through the side of her mouth) What a bunch of babies. (gasps) Wait a minute! Weird situation plus danger equals Phineas and Ferb! Okay, calm down. I'm on it! (dials her phone) Mom? Mom, I want you to check and see if the boys are creating zombies!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. Commence Operation Concisely State What The Heck Is Going On Around Here. Notepad: check! Ducky Momo 15th Anniversary Happy Pencil: check! Keen eye and indomitable will to bust: check!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Reading) "Sing, goddess, the anger of Peleus' son, Achilles..." (She dozes off, then shakes herself back awake, and continues reading) "Achilles! And it's devastation, which put pains upon the Achaeans..." (She doses off again, then jolts back awake, and continues her reading) "Upon the Achaeans, hurled in their multitude to the House of--"

Name: Candace
Dialog: Can, uh, can I say something? So I think I'm up to date on the whole Perry-agent thing. Strangely, that's the most normal thing that's happened this afternoon... But who exactly is this guy?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! (Runs to her) Mom! The boys are up to something huge! I just know it! But they've hidden it within a massive pile of leaves in the backyard. Come help me sort through them for a few hours to find it! (Pulls her out)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on phone) Ah, Stacy, I tell my mom I'm heading to the mall to get some makeup and she hands me a list of other stuff I have to get. Why do I have to do everything? Shop at the mall, bust my brothers.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, just put it there at the end. (Guiserblint pours some more gold at the end of the rug. Candace takes off her shoes.) Okay, you can go now. (She lifts her dress up and runs gleefully through the coins in her bare feet. She stops and a record needle scratch is heard.) Wow, I've been given all this power and how I've chosen to use it is to run through gold coins barefoot....I'm a genius!! (runs back to the throne) Ha ha ha!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait a minute wait a minute, what you're trying to say is that if Stacy is really my best friend, I should just apologize to her. And if I'm really Stacy's best friend, she'll take me back! (runs off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sold! (No audio, Ding) Well, what do you know? It works! (Ding, Cows mooing) Wait, stop! Uh oh. (Screams, Blows whistle) Hey, this cow whistle doesn't work!  (Haney briefly puts up the "Closed for Stampede" sign) Oh, they're so going to get it. (At phone) Mom, they're driving a herd of cattle right through Downtown.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No way, Phineas. There's no way I'm lettin' this baby out of my sight. This is the single greatest moment in my life, and there is nothing you little creeps can do to take it away from me. (Norms enters)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on her phone) You're not gonna believe this, Stacy, but when I turned around, Jeremy was standing right behind me. Well, actually he was sitting, and he was a couple blocks away, but he was right there!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Or we could've all been captured, and I wasn't gonna take that chance. These are the tough choices, people. Somebody's gotta be the adult here. You two are safe, and that's what important.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's it? That's all you're doing today? Huh. How normal. I guess my night's safe after all. Who would have guessed you two would get sucked into a video game? I'm going to go get ready.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No big deal? I'm Jeremy's girlfriend! We have to make a good impression! Breakfast is easy! This is brunch! Brunch! That's so fancy! Mom, what does this frittata say about us as a family?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (enthusiastically) Aaah! Yes! Vanessa's dad's machine! It worked! Which means yesterday is today! Another chance(steps on a rollerskate) to bust the boooo- (steps on a skateboard and rolls down the stairs) -ooys! I didn't think there would be this part!– ugh! (falls off the skateboard and loses the skate, lands in a wagon, and starts rolling around the house) Har... (pauses as she rolls behind a wall) dee har har.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on megaphone) People, people, I'm not gonna soft pedal this. That was adequate, but I think we're ready to witness the greatest architectural feat this town has ever seen! I give you Phineas and Ferb! (The boys uncover the tarp. But the crowd simply stares. Thaddeus and Mandy laugh.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm not speaking metaphorically! The boys' inventions disappeared every single day last summer! And, of course, Mom never sees it! It's always, "Who wants pie? Oh, there you are, Perry."

Name: Candace
Dialog: (To her phone in a panicked tone) Mom, things look pretty bleak. We may not be back after all. Phineas is in a cute trance. Mitch turned himself really adorable and defeated the entire Meap Army. There's no one left to-

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sighs) Well, I guess it could've been worse. (Aaand a bird poops on her) Okay, that does it. This thing is totally bad luck. Well; little amulet, this girl doesn't need any more misfortune. So bye-bye, bad luck! (tosses tiki charm into garbage can; mysterious music plays) Over it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Apparently Giraffe Girl has robbed me." "Ferb has been working out." "Excuse me; my child can't see the movie over your monstrous giraffe head!" Oh, I'll show them. I'll show them all.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You're so close, Candace! Don't cave now! The Mysterious Force is watching! So as long as you stay cool and casual. (to Mom) Come. Hee hee. Casually this way. MOM! (giggles) Here we go. Just walk with me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know, universe? If you were going to give me practically unbustable brothers, you could at least have made them not morning people. Yeah, I see ya down there. "Hey, where's Perry?"

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm going to the mall! I'll call Stacy. No, wait. Stacy's mad at me. And I'm mad at Stacy! But I can't go by myself. I'll look like a total dork. Okay, I'll just get a new best friend!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Talking on the phone) …So I said, "You're not getting me up into the mountains on a day like this", (She is on the couch with dozens of fans) I'm staying right here, with my beautiful air conditioning. I'm just gonna chillax right through this one.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Get my brothers to bust themselves? (in realization) Get my brothers to bust themselves. Get my brothers to bust themselves!! Get my brothers to bust themselves!!! Get my brothers to bust themselves!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, we've gotta split up. Ferb, hide Klimpaloon under your jacket to keep him quiet and I'll lure the guards the other way with my "Nang nang nang"! Just get him to the awards show!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Imagine, a whole day of hanging with Crash and the band! And, as an added bonus, (She turns a picture of Phineas and Ferb around.) a whole day of not thinking about my goofy brothers. (Gasps) Just me, you and The Bettys! (horn honks) Ahh, they're here!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's not their party, it's my party! And it's not a party, it's an intimate get together. (Shattering) (Gasps) What was that? Put that down, pardon me, use a napkin! What is my science teacher doing here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, no matter, because we're driving this thing home. I'm calling Mom to make sure she's there to see this. (dials phone) You're going too slow! Give me that thing! (takes remote) So, how does this thing work? (presses button, "I'm Lindana and I Wanna Have Fun!" plays, presses another button, activating windshield wipers, presses another button, the ATV does a loop)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) (laughs) That was funny. Belching. (laughs) It's so, uh... (laughs) Male (laughs) Right, bros? But yeah, maybe we should talk about something like, I don't know, does anyone have any deep thoughts they'd like to share?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (pacing back and forth) There's one thing I don't understand about the lost superpowers. In all the comics I've read, energy can never be destroyed. Only morphed into a different form or contained somehow.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You're not getting me into one of those things! I'm not showin' up for my TV debut lookin' like a complete weirdo! (to Stacy) What? I said, "Complete". (to the gang) And now, I must leave. My public awaits.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait. What? No! You guys keep working, I'll narrate the audiobook. (To Isabella) You stay here and help the boys. And not only will I finish recording your book today, I'll do it by four o'clock.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I know you want me to go left, but can't I technically make three rights to make a left? I mean, I know two wrongs don't make a right, but three rights do make a left, right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) Dee Dee? (dials phone) Stacy? Who's Dee Dee? A Swedish exchange student?! I gotta go. Hey, wait for me! Let me through! Let me through! Oh, out of my way! (climbs on a ski lift Vanessa is riding on; grumbling) My brothers are just driving me crazy!

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...But then, when I bring Mom into the backyard, it's gone and Mom never sees it. So here's my question, Mr. Supercomputer: How can I get my Mom to see what my brothers have done?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (inhales deeply) Sisters, I know what you're thinking, but rest assured, this new Candace that you see before you will not react like the crazed little girl that crawled in here just this morning.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! Building big, dangerous, bustable things with their imaginations! And also power tools. They even put up flyers. How'd they even get in here? Gotta go! I'll keep ya appraised.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, uh, doin' some shoppin'? I mean, duh! Of course, you're shopping. You've got the items in the little basket thingy. You placed them in there with the intent to— Stop, Candace.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Don't worry. I can do both! (grabs a pair of binoculars) I've got a perfect view of them from where I'm sitting. Oh, yeah, that's what I'm talking about. I'm all up in their grill and they don't have a clue!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Omigosh! Cutie Patootie! My long-lost pet rabbit! (Picks up Dennis) Where have you been?! Oh, honey bunny, was Perry bothering you? Poor little fluffy britches patootie pants, let me get you home.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Clearly overjoyed) What are you gonna do to them? No TV for a month? Or -- they have to serve me for a year. (gasps) How about confiscating their toolbox? (gasps) I know! Take away their seats on the city council!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) Then the boys' invention can't disappear before Mom sees it because she'll be in it! It's fool-proof! Phineas and Ferb will be busted once and for all! (grabs the camera) Can I borrow this? Thanks. (zips away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (nervously) Well, maybe he just wandered off. Doesn't he always wander off at some point in the day? A-And then later, when he comes back, you say, "Oh, there you are, Perry", and he says... (mimics Perry's chatter)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (strains and groans) I can't take it anymore!! Mom, I really tried my best to give you a day, but it's… the boys. The boys! They're in the parade! With giant floats! So come on, you gotta bust them. (Grabs her and runs off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah! You know what? You're right. (Climbs all the way up.) If I could do that, then I should be able to walk across the attic, right? It's being silly. Heck, I don't even remember what I was afraid of.

Name: Candace
Dialog: See? That's my point! Stuff's disappearing! and once it goes, nobody remembers it— (Phineas and Ferb get sucked up into another portal) e-ever existed... (inhales sharply) Moooooo- (runs inside to Linda, who is vacuuming the living room) -om! It took them! (hangs on Linda) Like the spoons! (inhales) Mom, Phineas and Ferb are gone!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know what people take for granted? The sounds of the summer: the way ice crackles in a cold beverage, the bees buzzing on their busy way, the chirping of the summer birds...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (after dialing the phone) Oh, it's busy! I've just gotta win! Clearly I'm their biggest fan. See? (Shows her Betty merchandise) Even my Betty boombox which rests on my Betty bedside table next to my Betty bed runs on Betty batteries! (Plays the boombox)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Right, hard to get. I'll call you back. (Presses button on phone to talk to Jeremy.) Umm, about the car and the ride, I would love to! (Candace screams. Jeremy holds the phone away from his ear as the force of Candace's scream makes his hair blow back.) Wait, I mean, I better check my schedule. (Covers phone and hums victory music to herself). You're in luck. I can just squeeze you in.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bwahahaha, letters to- Oh! Brilliant idea. Let's get together and write letters to Santa, and be very specific, within a reasonable price range. For fun. I'll be over in a bit.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, well, let's see. What's different this year than last year? Oh, I know! You went out and got everyone in Danville involved in one of your off-the-cuff, harebrained schemes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, what do you think I should wear to the fair tonight? I'm thinking my favorite red blouse with my white skirt and red matching socks. (Bowling pins crashing) Stacy, I'm gonna have to call you back.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Talking on phone while sitting in front of her computer) And then I typed LOL, but it came out LOP, and Jeremy thought I meant... (sniffs the air) What's that smell? I'll call you later, Stacy. (Hangs up and looks out window, seeing cheese delivery.) Cheese, huh? That warrants a call to Mom! (Perry flies by on his jet-pack as she begins to dial.) What was that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (walking towards her bedroom door) This is it, Candace – the last day of summer vacation! Your last chance to bust the (steps on a rollerskate) boooo- (steps on a skateboard and rolls down the stairs) -ooooooo – ugh! (falls off the skateboard and lands in a wagon, starts rolling around the house) Uh! Why do we have this many (pauses as she rolls behind a wall) wheeled objects lying around the house?

Name: Future Candace
Dialog: Now where do I go? More importantly when? I know, I'll set it for a day I know I can bust the boys. Back to the first day of that summer. The day they built the rollercoaster. (disappears)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm, like, so looking forward to tonight. A special evening, just the two of us. So, what do you have planned? Horseback riding? I just love horseback riding. Oh, you stopped.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah I know. Imagine if you had to choose between a blood-thirsty undead walking corpse and a slobbering hairy lupine man-beast for a boyfriend. (camera zooms on Candace) What could possibly be cooler? (shakes hand up knocking down the LIVE BAT from cage - Candace screams)

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! Wait! No! Ugh! No, I've been practicing diving, not skateboarding! Ugh. Everyone stop doing things that I'm not good at! (Jeremy falls off his skateboard, launching it to the top of the pool) Oh, this is a nightmare, come on Stacy, let's go-- (Candace steps on Jeremy's skateboard, and begins skating in the pool)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hm. Well, you can't do nothing forever. And when you stop doing nothing, I'll start doing something, and that something will be busting you! (She goes back inside and slams the door.) Look at them plotting my downfall. (She dials her phone.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, I'm so sorry. I'm gonna cancel with Jeremy today. Meet me at the cafe in half an hour and we'll hit the Street Fair afterwards. It'll be just the two of us. I promise.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? Oh, no, no, no, no, no. Can't you guys just find some old nuts and bolts lying around and jerry-rig up some kind of machiney-deely-bob and get us out of this situation?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (still smiling and gesturing) Me too! You wouldn't believe (stops smiling, but still has her eyes wide open) the day I'm having so far! I mean really. Like I could go on. Like I could tell you all about it. I mean there's a lot that happened and there's—

Name: Candace
Dialog: (wearing tennis rackets on her feet as if they were snowshoes) Alright. That should do it. I'll just walk all the way up to the top. Nothing will stand in my way. (falls deep in the snow) Why is it so dark out here? (A horse and sleigh ram her head) Ow! Oh, that hurts! Wait a minute. I got it! (has Buford ride her up the mountain; snickering mischievously).

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Jeremy's on his way over here right now. I've got like 5–10 minutes to get the whole "Busting-Phineas-and-Ferb" thing over so I can relax and we can enjoy our Saturday.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, actually, it's Candace, but I guess you can call me "Carl". There's a zebra that calls me "Kevin". Mysterious Force, if this is really you, I need you to show me a sign!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (With a fake British accent) As the fair princess in the tower, I declare Sir Charles the winner of the tournament... (Thinks using her normal voice) Wait a second. Could this be one of those things that backfires horribly on me? (Pauses) Nah.

Name: Candace
Dialog: She's talking numbers, kid. Don't get a big head. Okay, mom, now watch what happens when he has to make a choice. (to Baljeet) Baljeet, would you like some grapes, or this chocolate bar?

Name: Candace
Dialog: That is so not true. Who ever heard of something as silly as turning someone to stone...? (Looks at a statue) No, no, it can't be. (Screams) I did it again. Don't look at me! (Screams) I'm a monster! (Screams) Make it stop! (Screams) (She runs off into the distance after seeing all the statues that were already there beforehand.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aha! It's crawling with clues out here! Hmm... Look at these circular indentations in the dirt. (She sniffing) And the subtle scent of rubber in the air. By Jove, Stacy! What could it be?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (waving while holding DVDs) Hey, Vanessa! Just came by here to return (realizing it's Candace, Perry lets Doofenshmirtz out of a headlock and hides) your DVDs. Sorry I had them so long, can't say I understand French cinema. I mean, why does that mime keep letting go of balloons?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Time to embark on my daily 500-brush-stroke marathon to manageable hair. (She gets zapped.) One...What the—? (Takes out a protractor to measure her hair.) A perfect 40º angle? (smiles) I can't believe it! A perfect hair day! I finally got my PhD!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sarcastically) Mom, if you need me, I'll be outside with Phineas and Ferb. And when you get a break from your French lesson, feel free to pop outside and check out what we're doing, okay?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Clam it, wise guy! You know why I'm here and you better cooperate, because there are worse things than sittin' in a cold, dank prison cell with your little choo-choo train.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm a teenage girl. Nobody has to teach me how to use a cell phone. Now if you'll excuse me, me and little phonsie-wonsie have to make up for lost time. Okay? Yeah, we do.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't help myself! MOOOOOOOOOM! PHINEAS AND FERB BUILT A RODEO IN THE BACKYARD WITH MECHANICAL BULLS AND BLEACHERS AND IS REALLY DANGEROUS! COME ON, YOU GOTTA BUST THEM! (drags Linda with her)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, Candace, you can do this! What's a couple little spiders compared to the fate of the world? (climbs back down) Oh, who am I kidding?! I need support! (She dials her phone.) Stacy, I really need your help!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Definitely! Definitely. Just, you know, taking it easy, and not being interested in anything the boys may or may not, mayhaps be participating in or thereabouts, casually.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Can you believe how hot it is today, Jeremy? Even my dollies are sweating! Not that I play with dolls. I just happen to have a couple on my shelf next to my unicorn. Heh. (slaps her forehead in realization of what she just said)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I am so excited for some solid girl time with you guys tonight! I thought we could enjoy this charcuterie board, then play truth-or-dare, then watch a movie on my laptop!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh? What are they up to today? Do they really think they can escape Mom's wrath by hiding in this fun, massive, glorious, autumnal leaf pile? Well, not if I can help it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hmmm. The low stakes have definitely been raised. But, as always, it would be pointless to get Mom because, as always, the Mysterious Force would just take this all away.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. This is your pile of buildy stuff. This is what you liked to do before you became boring. Now take this. (hands hammer to Ferb) Well? Let's get this thing going! Do your stuff! You, here! (hands a plank and spring to Phineas)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why, yes. Yes I am. Okay, I'll get this thing started. And then because they're men, they'll want to take over and show me how to do it. Then I'll call Mom and bust them!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on the phone) Hehehehehehehehehehehehe... This is gonna be awesome, Stace! So when they get home, I'm gonna drag both of them into the backyard and it'll be a busting feeding frenzy!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I got nothing. Every day, I wear myself out trying to bust the boys and it always blows up in my face. (throws some milk on a cat) I'm gonna take a day off from exploding face. Today is for me time.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, you're telling me that I could have had fun throughout this entire adventure if I had only stepped off the yellow sidewalk and joined my doofus brothers? Is that it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, (Scoffs) that's the dumbest thing I- (she dives out of the way as cows rush on board the space ship) Phineas and Ferb, I'm going to count backwards from 10, and when I'm done, you'd better be down here so I can bust you! (The ramp starts retracting) 10… 9… 8… 7… 6…

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, I have a confession to make. The only reason I said I liked extreme sports was because I was embarrassed that you caught me buying all that hygiene stuff for myself.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (She calls Phineas' phone) Phineas, quick, Mom is in danger! (She screams before hanging up) And the award goes to... Oh, wait, shoot. (She calls him again) On the corner of Fourth Street and Maple Drive! (screams before hanging up again) Beautiful! Now it's all up to The Dangiraffe.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come out to the backyard and see what the boys have made, and I'll be your best friend! I'll only apply to local colleges. I'll put you in the nice senior care facility!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from inside, chuckles) Oh, Jeremy, I had no idea you felt that way about me. (she is talking to a paper mache Jeremy.) But I still have a lot to accomplish before I get married. (pause) Hold on. (puts candles between it) Much more romantic. (her video phone rings) It's you! (on phone, in dreamy voice) Hello, Jeremyyyy!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, Stace! It's Candace. Where are you? Call me! Hmm. That's weird. Who else can I call? I know! Jenny! I haven't seen her since the boys built a beach in the backyard.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, if I get Mom to dress up as me, then the Mysterious Force will be fooled into letting what the boys built stay! (gasps) That's it! All I need is some kind of Candace suit!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, come on, come on! Mom! Hurry, hurry, hurry! Wait till you see it! Come on, come on, come on, come on! (The backyard is empty.) Uh, what?!?! Anybody needs me, then I'll be on the couch. (She walks back inside.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Meh. Still lucky. (gasp) I'll actually be able to bust Phineas and Ferb today! Oh, wait. Mom's at that weekend-long plant-potting retreat. (Her phone rings.) Hi, Mom! The seminar's over already?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasps) Phineas and Ferb! That's absolutely beautiful. And absolutely bustable! (returns to the spa) Mom, the boys tied massive circus balloon animals to the ship and we're flying through the sky!

Name: Candace
Dialog: {**Editor's Note:** Until Perry and Candace switch back, this transcript refers Perry in Candace's body as Perry/Candace and Candace in Perry's body as Candace/Perry.}

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, go ahead. Eat all you want. My dreams are smashed to pieces, and all you can think of is food! Well, just remember, Gaston said I'll always be his Cou de Crayon.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Can't gab, Stace. I'm in the middle of taking the minutes of everything my brothers do to give itemized documentation to Mom proving that the boys were building today!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! Barf-aroni with cheese! Stacy, please. Phineas and Ferb are doing something totally bustable that's also mobile. We can lure them right to Mom to bust themselves.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Right, stay focused. (Meap next pulls out a picture of the space station) They're in a giant spaceship. But how are we supposed to get up there and save them? (Meap grabs the baseball launcher, and shoots a baseball into the sky) Oh! I get it. Duh. You're trying to tell me something. (Pause) What?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Blah blah blah blah blah, you could disappear forever and so could every memory of your existence. So here's the part you need to pay attention to! Are you listening?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Alright, guys, it's do or die time. This is the chance to really show your stuff, cuz there's no way you're gonna lose to a couple of lame-os and their loser sister!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Could it really be possible? Could Phineas and Ferb actually be doing nothing? You're right, Mom. I should just try and relax until Stacy picks me up for the concert.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Busting my brothers? I've spent every day of my life trying to protect my little brothers. I had to grow up pretty quick around here to make sure they didn't have to.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, who can say really? But, you know, sometimes, we do naughty things without ever having any idea they're naughty. Sometimes we do an entire summer's worth of them. (glares at Phineas)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy? (at the robot) Thank you. (at Jeremy) Jeremy! Oh, it's so good to talk to you. No, I'm so sorry about that. I was just on the top of a tree, and I didn't have any service. And then I...

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: This is just beautiful. I decide to do the right thing, and I end up in a cell. (she looks out the barred window) Well, at least my brothers are safe... (she lays on the cot and bounces the ball) What lesson am I supposed to be learning here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, come on! Yes! Mom's coming! (Linda is shown running towards the house.) I just wanna remember this moment. Relish it. Revel in it. Bask in the sunlight of pure, busting bliss! (gleefully pulls on her hair; hears the Baby-Cry-inator's wail; lets go her hair.) What is all that racket?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, Stacy. Let's get busy. I have a city to run. (walks out the door) The task force recruits are looking pretty good. Wait a minute. New law: I'm the only one who can wear that color!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, well I'm all done with outer space. Never again! I'll stick with Earth, where I'm the one in charge of busting people who do stuff they're not supposed to do.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Standing around, dorking it up, boring. There's just too much for one person to do. If only there were two of me, one to bust my brothers and one to be with Jeremy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No problem, Stacy. I mean, I am a little disappointed that I'll miss out on busting my brothers today, but at least I get to serve food to a room full of strangers.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes...I...am. (clap clap) Bring me a glass of water (Guiserblint produces a glass) and a cracker. (A woman behind her gets a cracker.) Okay, bring me an x-ray of a kangaroo with three legs. (Guiserblint shows the X-ray, while another man holds up three mannequin legs) No, no, the kangaroo has three legs. (Another man shows the x-ray of the kangaroo with three legs) Ah! There you go.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sighs) Feels like I don't exist anymore, like I'm a nobody. (Sighs) I wish I could go to some cool faraway place and start over. Wait a minute. Those are Phineas and Ferb's bikes!

Name: Candace
Dialog: The feeling that the, uh, bust is a-brewin'. Phones down! I need you to take this seriously, Mother! Now raise your right hand. You're gonna take the Busting Oath.

Name: Candace
Dialog: All right! Let's blow this pop stand! (pauses) What? (another pause) Oh, fine. (at Lion-Tiger-Bear Guy (Buford)) My friends and I are going to Bustopolis to each get something from the Wizard. Do you want to come? There!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. (to Buford) I can't watch because it'll compromise the experiment. But if you go out there and the Mysterious Force thinks you're Mom, the pogo stick shouldn't be there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (does a spit take and gasps) I've got an idea! My brothers are probably building something in our backyard right now, and we can use the surveillance satellite to catch them doing it! (runs off) Come on!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (hangs up) Well, she's no help. I'm gonna have to do this myself. (climbs back up) It's just you and me, attic. You and me... (climbs back down) and about TEN HUNDRED GAZILLION SPIDERS!! OH, I CAN'T DO THIS!!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, no, mom! Grrrrr! The one time it actually could've worked! But no, they had to be boring! And we had to build a stupid, worthless, ridiculous... (steps on the object which is actually a rocket and she flies around) AAAAAAHHH!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: The "Brawl at the Mall"? (She goes outside to the parking lot where Phineas and Ferb are making a boxing ring) What do you two think you're doing? You can't just go building a boxing ring out here in the mall parking lot! I'm telling Mom right now! (On her way, she takes another picture of Jeremy; Back at the Squat 'n Stitch, Linda's trio's gig is still in session)

Name: Candace
Dialog: NO! Nononono! You don't know what you're going to do today. They're going to build some sort of wedding rocket to the moon, or lawn gnome beach party of taffeta!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Screams) Oh, help somebody! Oh, get it off me! These are designer jeans! (She sees Suzy near the sprinkler handle) Wait, what are you doing? (She turns the handle turning on the sprinklers and getting Candace wet and her hair soggy. She screams) No, no! Ah! My hair! Help! No-- (She falls in the mud) Huh? (Suzy laughs maniacally as she makes her toy truck spray mud all over Candace’s face and hair) Ahh! Why are you doing this to me?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, hi, Mom, how are you? Oh, that's neat. I was wondering if you'd care to come home at your leisure, if that's convenient for you. Or not. Y'know, totes chill.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Don't worry. (She gives Monogram-2 her Bo staff.) If you ever get in a pinch, you know where to find me. Now if you'll excuse me, there's something I've been putting off that I need to take care of.

Name: Candace
Dialog: The logical explanation IS the mysterious force. The real question is, why does it care so much about my little brothers? Why doesn't it want them to get busted?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, pffft, it's not that. I mean, they did build something, but it's long gone already. No, I just had a question, what did you say I had to do for chores today?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's really perfect! (The beam hits Candace.) I'm glad Mom's gone for the day 'cause my biggest fear is that this is just gonna fly away before Jeremy gets here. (car horn honks, Candace gasps) And there he is! (runs off) Woohoo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ow! Hey, watch it, brats! (Cut to her approaching a couple of kids burying their friend in the sand.) No! You're supposed to bury everything except the head! Hey, no! We do not drink the lake water! (Cut to two kids holding cups. Wide shot to reveal an older man sipping the water through a drinking straw.) That goes for your children, too, sir!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (after opening the door to the garage) Listen up! Jeremy will be here any second and I wanna tell you... (notices Isabella's sandwich) Ooh, grilled cheese, my favorite. Might as well eat now, so I don't look like a pig on my date.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, maybe they're acting up today. Ugh, I should've known better. I'll have to call you back, Stacy. A little Buford's telling me the boys are up to something.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom mom mom! Come with me. Phineas and Ferb created a new language and everybody's speaking it, and now we can't understand anybody! Watch this! What time is it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's just like the Trojan horse from history class. They'll accept this as a gift, then after everyone falls asleep, we'll jump out and rescue Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb built this portal to Mars and I went through it and was crowned queen of the Martians. Now I know it sounds crazy, but this time, I have proof.

Name: Candace
Dialog: They're right, I could lose. But I can't give up now! I'm the queen of Skiddley Whiffers. And I'm not gonna let anything break my streak. NOW TOSS ME THAT DICE!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on, Irving. (plugs her phone into the wall, switching the video feed to show Phineas and Ferb's ball) Yes! Everyone, can I have your attention please? (everyone turns to face Candace) My brothers and their friends will be dropping from outer space in that giant New Year's ball.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait! No mom, you can't! (Linda turns off the phone.) Oh, wait, wait! Uhh... (at Jeremy) Stay right there! (runs off) I've got to stop her! (Looks out the backyard gate) Oh, no, no, no, no... (Linda arrives) Mom, Mom, pleeaaasee, Mom! Go away! Don't come in!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Echoing) Um, hello? Phineas? Ferb? You two are in big trouble? (Door slams, Wind blowing) (Candace runs and tries to open the door but it’s locked) Okay, you guys, stop fooling around. You guys better come out now. I'm getting really mad. (Skeleton cracking)(Candace turns around) What was that?! (She then turns back around and sees a monster and screams, she then runs off into the haunted house. the monster takes its head off to reveal Milly, Ginger, and Gretchen)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm always here. It's Mom who's never here to see the boys. Wait! Their stuff only disappears when Mom comes out to see it. It's okay with me seeing it, right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb made a dangerous...thing in the backyard, in the dark. Oh this stupid fence! Why do we have this stupid fence here? Dad, tear down this fence!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, what if while I'm asking him, a satellite falls out of orbit and crashes into the— Wait a minute, what is going on out there? I'll call you back, Stacy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Easter Island? Who makes an app that sends people to Easter Island? (a bird grabs her cell phone) Hey, come back here! I need that to get home! (runs over a cliff and screams, then catches the edge of it) Oh, that was close. Talk about a cliffhanger.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sighs) I guess it's too much to expect some magic answer to all my problems. (breaks cookie) Let's see. "Somebody close to you will take a trip." Boy, I hope they take me with them.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to the boys, whispers) Guys, it's me, Candace. We've come to bust you out of here. Now's our chance. (shouts) RUN! (to Sergeant) Just testing. Wow, you've done a great job of turning them into, uh...that.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You should see the models in these spreads. So indifferent. So uninterested. So cool! (puts magazine back on rack) I wonder if you and I will ever be this cool. What are you doing, Stacy?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm just gonna go for a walk. (A group of Martians points to a Mars Rover) Uh...uh...guys, not now, okay? (more Martians surrounds her) No no, really, I would just like to got for a walk alone. (Groaning) (At Phineas and Ferb) There you are! Where've you guys been?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (dreamy voice) Yeeeaaahhh... (needle scratch) Huh? Uh -- wait -- what did you say? Jeremy? No! Jeremy! (to the paper mache) I'll be right back. (runs out to the living room, panicking) Mom! Mom!  Moooom! Jeremy's dropping off his little sister and I --

Name: Candace
Dialog: (gasp) This is Jeremy's house! And there's Jeremy! At last! A silver lining! I can find out where we're goin' tonight! A girl's gotta know what a girl's gotta wear.

Name: Candace
Dialog: A real Bigfoot? Oh, give it a rest, Phineas! Everyone knows there's no such thing as a real- (sees Bigfoot behind her. The monster roars.) Oh, fine. What's this one made of? Popsicle sticks and glitter?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Or maybe it's his secret inner thoughts written as a sonnet. No, no, no, no, that's not it! I gotta think more like my brothers. Y'know, use my imagination.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (growls, gets out of bed, and shouts out the window) And I know what I'm gonna do today! Bust you guys once and for all! Do your worst or your— you know, just make it (starts feeling the familiarity of the conversation) big and... bustable, so I can show... Mom.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (singsong) Hey Mom?! I want to show you something! (normal voice, looks back) Yep, I'm one step ahead of you boys, one step. What the heck is this thing!? (presses antenna, shrinks) (Gasps) I'm shrunk! (Crashing noise as the shrinking machine falls next to her) Where's the reverse button?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, all summer long, you build the most amazing things and the one time I reach out to you as a sister, the one time I count on you, you give me this?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Save the camera, save-save the cam-- Save the camera. Save the camera, save the camera, save the camera. (Notices bike) Save the camera, save the camera, save the camera!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in her bedroom; on video phone) I'm totally sunk, Stace! I've been working on Jeremy's birthday present for months, but it's not even close to being as good as I want it to be. (Cut to reveal she's working on a popup book showing their first kiss.) Ugh! Lame!

Name: Candace
Dialog: then I can only continue my benign reign and spread love, happiness and ultimate popularity throughout my kingdom! If you would just let me have my moment!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom'll be here any minute. (She runs back toward the backyard door.) I can do it all! I'm a multitasking master! Ugh. Actually, I think this multitasking thing is overrated. (sits on the couch) It's too many taskings.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys are making such a racket that I can't focus. And I need time to fix my hair. 'Cause when Jeremy gets here, I don't wanna be wearing this stupid...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy? Jeremy? Oh, what a beautiful tiara... neck, uh, broach... hmm... bracelet! (gasps) Oh, it's absolutely beautiful! (flings it into the sewer) Whoops! No! No! No! No! (reaches for the object) Almost got it... (water rushes in and carries the object away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, this is amazing! I'm at an actual party with cool older girls! They know everything! They're so AHHHH! They're awesome! You've gotta get over here.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Build a haunted house, my foot! (Phone dialing) They're so busted. Yes, hello. This is an emergency. I'd like to speak with Linda Flynn. To whom am I presently speaking?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Wearing fish glasses) They're not getting away with this. I know what I'm getting. I'm gonna get this disposable camera, and then I'll finally have proof, and I can bust them!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy, don't worry, I promise I'll explain everything later, but right now you've gotta get out of here. (pushes him away) I'll call you later...I mean, tomorrow. Phew...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (From her window) Ah, look at them out there. What are they up to? Ah, it looks like Phineas is saying "Where's Perry?" Huh. Where do you think Perry goes everyday, Stace?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb!!! Why do you always build these things??! It's impossible to bust you for everything!!! It's not my job!!! Not my job!!! (realizes) ...Not my job?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (desperate) It's a good thing I play the balalaika! (Balalaika disappears) It's a good thing I play the bagpipe! (Bagpipe disappears, verge of crying I should've manned the omelet station!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?!! No-no-no-no-no, where's the Eiffel Tower? (runs up to them and feels around) Oh, wait. I've seen this, it's invisible! I've just got to find it! (Cuts to a bored Linda and the surprised mothers, she continues offscreen.) It has to be around here somewhere!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Do I look like someone who wants their moleculars transported? Now get that stinky pet out of our cabinets and go scramble your molecules somewhere else!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, I have got to take a new picture of myself for my blog. I didn't realize mine is already a week old. (She takes a selfie; her new selfie is exactly the same as her old one.) That's better. (She walks off, but snaps back to the garage entrance as she notices the boys working on the car.) What are you doing to Mom's car?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (giggling) Well, Phineas, what do you think? Wait. Before you say anything, look at these photos. I stalked "Ferb" all day. (shows Phineas some photos) See? Proof positive. Ferb...is an alien.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I mean it usually disappears as soon as the kids are done playing on it-- (Gets an idea) Oop! Wait a minute, that's it! (At the gang) You guys gotta play on it! Go! Go have fun! Go!

Name: Candace
Dialog: That was a fake! I only did it to get into a concert! If it wasn't for Isabella and my brothers I never could have done it. (Melissa gasps in shock) Now will you please save me?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I know. I've done this nineteen other times. (with her eyes closed) But this time, I can say with the utmost confidence that there are Phineas and Ferb robots in our backyard!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) You didn't. But your girlfriend did. Yeah that's some girlfriend you've got there. I'd say you're the luckiest man alive to have a girlfriend like that.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, yeah. I don't care about any of that! I lost the gift Jeremy made for me, and you guys have to make an exact duplicate before he comes over!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, I know I did all 50 and I made sure to plant the markers and everything! (She holds up the marker that she forgot to place at DEI.) Huh? Looks like I forgot one. I'll just run back before it's five o'clock! (She starts to leave, but the clock chimes 5:00, meaning time's up.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, Vanessa, you're you! Everyone's talking in weird accents. My brothers are scheming to take over, I think, (imitating Doof) "the entire Tri-State Area" (normal voice) with inators!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay? Mom, I feel great! What Dr. Shamai went through just once completely broke him! I go through that every day! (gasps) And look at me! I'm doing just fine!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Puh-leese. Trick-or-Treating is for kids. I'm like, way more mature than that. I'm walking with you until we get to Jeremy's, and then I am outta here.

Name: Candace
Dialog: And, ew! Look at this. "Baljeet's summer wig. Store at room temperature"? (notices a nearby billboard) Huh? The Morty Williams Show? Wait a second. I've got a plan. It's foolproof.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gangway, on your right. One side, coming through. (trips over Perry) (at Phineas) Aaaah! How many times have I told you to keep Perry out of my way when I'm balancing eggs on a spoon?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, Candace, you're at a Bango-Ru-themed birthday party for a little girl who despises you. I just hope no one objects to a giraffe marrying a lemur.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well it kind of had this bolty screw thing going on, and this wrapped wire like... Oh, I know what it looks like, but I don't know how to describe it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bzzzzz! Bzzzzz! Mom! It's me! Mom!!! You need to bust the boys and get them to turn me back into me before Jeremy gets back here! (wide shot as Candace realizes she's in the car with Linda, who starts the ignition) What?! (She flies in place but not before smashing into the window) Help meeeeee!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uhh! Mom, come home quick! There's a giant mob, I'm a super fiend, I'm roasting them with laser vision, and - Hey, what do you mean, "Psychotic rant"?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! I guess we'll just have to get him on the next level. (looks at detergent) Did I put the..? (shrugs) Hmm. (puts in the last of the detergent) Better clean than dirty. (Closes the lid and turns the washing machine on.) I'm one totally focused multitasking genius!

Name: Candace
Dialog: So if Phineas and Ferb are up to something bust-worthy, and I am, as you say... (squeezes Linda's cheeks) "In charge", I have free reign to call you as many times as necessary?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aw, man. (takes out more cash) Okay, okay, paying customer here. (suppressed burp, to Jeremy) Hit me with another chili dog, but hold the onions. Anyway, as I was saying, how nice to be taking a break?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I promise I won't break this promise. See ya in a bit! (hangs up) Now, to call Jeremy. Wait, why call him, when I can tell him I can't see him today...in person? (runs off to do so)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (talking loudly) Okay, I get it. Lesson learned. Toddlers aren't easy! The irony is not lost in me! Little help here? (to the camera) This had better wear off before the next episode.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, no! No, no, no, no, no! You can't just tear up the town with your chariots and expect to get away with it! When Mom and Dad find out about this...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ech! No. You stay here. Nobody move. If we leave, this thing'll disappear. She'll be out here in two minutes, with her bird watching group. I'll wait.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really? You're letting complete strangers in? I'm the owners' sister. I demand to be let in right now! I'm supposed to be having the time of my life!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Grrrr! Don't you realize I have a very important party to go to?! If you're going to all this trouble, you could have built us a bridge back to town!

Name: Candace
Dialog: And I am absolutely 100% positive that I have to bust my brothers! I can see it in your eyes! You know I'm right! Sisters, will we bust our brothers?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sleeping next to a framed photo of her boyfrined; yawns) Good morning, Jeremy. (fake boy voice) Good morning, gorgeous. (normal voice) Oh, Jer! (Candace giggles and rubs a framed photo of herself against the Jeremy photo, making kissing sounds. She is soon alerted to power tools whirring and thumping) I'll be right back, Jeremy. (she looks out of the window) What's going on? (Ferb has just set up the tent) A circus? Can't they give me a break for one day?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What did I tell you? Weird. Now, let the professional handle this before it gets out of hand. Why don't you make your own gelatin and leave us alone?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Some sort of silly game. As a lady, I'm not terribly interested in such foolishness. I'm much more interested in curtsying and other dainty pursuits.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait! Don't go! I haven't had fun yet! (Starts spinning around in the pink portal from before) Hey, what's happening? No! No! I'm waking up! I don't want to! This isn't fair! I didn't have any fun! No! No!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! It'll be too late! The stores will all be closed! And by "stores" I mean "the post office", and "by buying a gift", I mean "mailing the letters".

Name: Candace
Dialog: Don't you remember anything from orientation? Rebels are cruel, heartless sub-humans who are messing up the galaxy! And I am all about law and order.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm training for this year's father daughter picnic competition. And I'd really like to win for a change. Dad, c'mon! We're not finished practicing!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on the phone) Yes, Stacy. They're building something out there. But I decided the problem is I always jump the gun. So I'm gonna wait 'til just the right moment--

Name: Candace
Dialog: Seriously, a platypus crosses the Atlantic Ocean, finds you on the vast continent of Africa and no one feels this is worthy of a longer discussion?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? And let you fall? You may be a pain, but you are my brother. (She and Phineas hug) Besides, I still have that big rocket for evidence. What happened to the rocket? (Rocket explodes)

Name: Candace
Dialog: We gotta do something! We need fuel! Wait! I have an idea that just might work. And don't think I don't know what you're up to. I'll be right back.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, great. Hey, wait! There's nowhere to have a rollerskating derby, remember? The old derby track got torn down and turned into a tattoo parlor!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Blocking her view of the parade with her menu) Remember the Pharaoh's Curse...! (gets an idea) Wait! It doesn't count if she sees them herself! (to Linda) Hey mom, I bet you can't turn your head 180 degrees like an owl.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, what else? Ah! (She walks up to a couple drinking outside a French café. She takes the man's mug.) 'Scuse. Hot cocoa! (Snaps the mug and sips.) Not bad, although Jeremy prefers it with a little more cinnamon. (Walks away.) I gotta make a note of that for the boys.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ha! I beg to differ. Yes, they're both obnoxious, but my brothers' stuff has a sprinkling of awesomeness...which makes it that much more annoying!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (From atop of the diving board; clears throat) There's been a lot of talk around here about diving and snakes and diving with snakes and snakes into pools filled with piranha and sulfuric acid—

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys are SOOOO busted! I'm calling Mom right now. (realizes) Oh, no. I don't have the phone! (car honks) That's Mom! When she finds out I lost it, my life is ruined!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I just got mine too. He's a cross between a cow and a frog. I'm calling him "Señor Frowg". He's gonna be the cutest thing, you're just going to...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, all summer I've been stressing about busting my brothers, but after your speech this morning I just gave up. And now I'm much more relaxed.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I'll probably try to bust you guys... again! And fail... again! And add another link on my summer-long chain of disappointment and regrets.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait a minute. (smiles) The photo transporter! All I have to do is put my mom's photo in the machine, then she'll be transported right to the boys! Right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I think cheerleaders are overrated anyway. I mean, being gorgeous and popular? Does that matter in the real world--? (Her room goes dark due to the snow blocking her window.) What is going on out there?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (growls, gets out of bed, and shouts out the window) And I know what I'm gonna do today! Bust you guys once and for all! Do your worst or your best. Just make it big and bustable, so I can show Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (looking at Ferb's outfit in the gift shop) Why is it every store sells this outfit? (notices the balloons) Mom, mom! Look what Phineas and Ferb are doing! Come quick! (points at the outfits and the head-shaped balloons behind them) Look, look! Right there! You see?! You see?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Falls backward and screams as the car disintegrates) This is a car, mom! It just needs to...uh...uh...uh...see? (puts a clump of the Nano-bots in her hand) Vroom vroom! Okay. I'll admit, this does make me look a little bit...you know...crazy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Actually, I think I could use that. And I'm gonna take all of these as backups because you know something's gonna go wrong. (opens a door) Got any more in here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Must...get...tickets... (Cut to shot of the computer. Candace is typing www on the address bar, but her finger stays on the "w" key. Cut to reveal her face lying on the keyboard.) Zzzzzzzzzzzz... (She takes her head out of the keyboard to reveal many keys in her face. They pop out to the music of "Shave and a haircut, two bits". She spits two keys out of her mouth.) Oh, still not on sale! (A crash is heard) What the?! (Candace opens the window and sticks her head outside.; to the boys in the backyard with some pieces of their latest big idea in their hands.) Hey, isn't it a bit early to start building another crazy contraption?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes! Maybe I can finally bust the boys once and for all if I use Holmes' method of deduction! Come on. This will be fun! You could be Dr. Watson.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ahem. Citizens of Danville, it is now time for your princess....me....to start the Running of the Chinchillas! I now summon my tuber troubadour!

Name: Candace
Dialog: See, Mom?! See, see?! (Sees nothing on the counter) WHAT?!! But it was right here!!! I swear there was this machine...and we were tiny...but then we got bigger... (rest is under) and, and...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Here and here. And listen to this: (She plays a tape recorder which produces no sound.) See? That is an entirely different silence than the Ferb silence we're used to. Here, I'll play it backwards. (She reverses the tape; no sound comes out.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from inside) Yoo-hoo! Sir Charles! (cut to her) They can't even hear me up here. (She yells) Yo, Chuck! (Growls) What is going on down there? (She attempts to open the door, but only manages to pull the handle off) Oh, come on! Hey, guys! I am locked in the tower!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know, I can't really leave right now, I mean, clearly, I'm gonna have some serious busting to do around here, and you understand, don't you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? (she sees her mother walking by the wreckage) Is that Mom? You know I love you guys and I'm super glad we made up, but would you look at this place? Sorry, but you are SO BUSTED!! Mom! (And there she goes again.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know, Mrs. Garcia-Shapiro, every time I try to show my mom something, it disappears and she thinks I'm crazy. What do you think I should do?

Name: Candace
Dialog: This is so cool! I should call Jeremy and tell him. (looks at cell phone) Oh, there's no service in here. Nice. (at three of the ants) You there! Make there be cell service for your queen!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (talking fast) Anyway, when I try to bust them, everything will just magically disappear. Always happens. you'll see. Well, you won't see. I'll see, trust me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (runs into the backyard) Ha! You guys are sooooo busted! (sees the gorge) Look at this, it's even better than I thought! There's no way you're gonna get out of this one! (runs off) Oh, Mom? Mom?!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in her room) Okay, Stacy. We've got about ten minutes until Jeremy's party, so you've gotta help me decide. (Pulls out two swimsuits, only very slightly different colors) Should I go with this swimsuit or this swimsuit?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Downstairs; carrying a glass of water) Ugh, no more peach and pumpernickel sandwiches before bed. (Candace trips over Agent P, she looks back) You! (Perry, back in his pet mode, chatters. She picks him up and puts him outside) For an animal that doesn't do much, you sure know how to make a mess of things!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Just take your time, it's not like the earth is gonna open up and s-wallow it, (chuckles, tosses pie in the air) not today! (splat!) Oof. (gasps) Oh no! That means... (runs into the house) MOOOOM!!! MOM MOM MOM MOM!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) So, what you're telling me is that what you say is exactly what you mean? Like nothing more, nothing less, you say it, you mean it, that's it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, I mean, it's cool. I got this, though. Jeremy and I are working on his Perry film project. Also, the boys have a project you should see.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Walking out the front door) Hello, ladies! (Runs up to them, pushes Linda) Come on, come on, moms! (She drags Biffany offscreen, Mrs. Tjinder and Mrs. Du Bois follow.) I can't wait to see the looks on your faces when you see the spectacle that's in the backyard, come on!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, F.R.E.E.P.O., uh, Frequent Rampages Encourages Enormous Perpendicular Octagons. Uh, Free Raccoons Enter Existential Plastic Origami. Oh...

Name: Young Candace
Dialog: (on video) First on the list, invent an ice cream flavor, win a first-grade spelling bee, ride a unicorn. Tho if you're watching, Future Candathe, don't—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh, you've got to be kidding me! Jeremy will be heartbroken when he finds out I lost my gift! (Gasps) Phineas and Ferb! (runs into the backyard) Hey. What are you guys doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: The café, movie theater...it just all seems so...so ordinary. I just gotta find something cool to do to get me outta my rut. Wanna come along?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Brother, these Harbor Days festivals are so lame. I can't wait to see this year's lame-o replica of the great white shark of Danville Harbor!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sobs to Mom via phone) So I can never be perfect! No matter what I do, I'll always be two inches too ugly! I need a sudden growth spurt in the next fifteen minutes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Thanks, Buford. (Gives him a treat) Now all I need to do is find my Jeremy. Oh no! He's talking to Dee Dee! I gotta put a stop to this! Oh, Jeremy! (slips on the ice) Wait! Jeremy!

Name: Future Candace
Dialog: It IS them! I bet they traveled here from the past. (climbs up the tree) Awww, look how cute and... BUSTABLE they look. Wait, isn't this just a digital tree? (falls down) AAH!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You don't have to be Sherlock Holmes to—Ooh! Stacy, that's it! Who did we stay up all night learning about? (she hakes her) Who is the total king of busting?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, that's because they build something everyday. Seems like every time I get Mom and I'm ready to bust, their stupid invention disappears.

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...and catch two leaves between two pieces of wax paper, and choose matching backpacks, and sharpen a hatchet, (opening the gate) and we'll live on nothing but—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Preparing to relax. (walks out of the hotel) Boy, do I need this.... Ugh, why are there so many people here? Wait! Wait! One last chair! (Leaps onto the chair...before getting sat on by the guy who WAS going to sit there) Excuse me! I was here first!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Telegraph? Uggh! Good thing I went to that Morse code camp three summers in a row. (A now seemingly tiny Candace jumps onto the telegraph.) "Boys built old-timey town. No building codes. Get home." (laughs)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I would have super mind control and use telepathy and telekinesis to keep you super-dweebs under control with your lame-o superpowers.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sorry, Jeremy, I got distracted. I know. Let's up the production value. Come here, Perry, it's showtime! (pours the food into the dish) I got this multitasking thing down. (She looks out the window, but the food falls onto the floor, missing the dish. The Perry-bot dives into the food.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Can you believe this? Making us ride the bus pod? (Buford is looking in the bag when he realizes something.) They better give us a Rebel-fighting job this time and not just running some more errands.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Now, as I was saying before I was so lamely interrupted, I'm going to show everybody a real dare-devil dive. (The Beam from Doofenshmirtz's -inator hits the pool, evaporating it) Oh, well that's just not fair!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, Jeremy. You weren't gonna let me down. I just wanted you to come out with me and have a good time! And you know, dance 'til we're sick!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You mean that really cute one with the polka dots? (goes out on her bike) I know what she wants. Cute little sundress. Cute little sundress. Cute little sundress.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (walking around town) Perry? Perry the Platypus! Huh? (notices a tail sticking around a nearby corner.) Perry! Get over here. (runs over and pulls on the tail) You're coming home with me so I won't get in trouble with the… (A woman taps her on the shoulder and Candace sees it's not Perry or a platypus, but a beaver she was pulling.) You have a pet beaver?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (throwing things at the window) Mom. Mom. Mom. I may as well try that dumb remote. (uses the remote several times) Oh, yeah, I'm free as a bird. (tosses the remote away; narrows eyes then grabs the box) Okay, what else? Oh, yeah, this thing and this. Big whoop.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sighs) What am I gonna do, Stace? Jeremy wants to spend time with me, but the best thing I could come up with is the mall! That's how boring I am!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Phineas and Ferb are building a huge glass and sand thing in the yard, it looks like a giant ant farm, but I don't know what it does!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (nervous chuckle as she pulls on her shirt collar) Yeah, that's a puzzler. But you know that old saying: "Never question the source of a...temporal time...space...loop thingy."  Heh heh. Eh.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, did you, now? Well, if I didn't have to haul water, sweep the barn, collect eggs, spin a quilt, and do whatever this is, I'd tell mom. (She walks off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Of course, it had to be wild parsnips. Allergy pills, allergy pills. Aha! Quick! Before my voice goes through the reaction. (She finds there are no pills left. She now has in a deep, manly voice) Noooooooooooo!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dr. Shamai, you said to call when it's happening. It's happening! The Mysterious Force just zapped the boys' invention and it disappeared!

Name: Candace
Dialog: And that concludes my dissertation on modern investigative techniques for establishing proof of guilt, with or without physical evidence.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, sure. From way back. It started 'cause I had to do a lot of research to get up to speed for the Ducky Momo superhero crossover event.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You go, girl! I haven't seen the boys building anything, so it's pretty chill here. But I feel kinda unfulfilled not having to bust them.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, Mom, I've gotta get to Stacy's! Love ya! Bye! Oop! (sees the device) Mom Mom! Mom!! C'mere! Look what Phineas and Ferb made in the front yard! Quick!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Exactly! And with infallible fortune cookie guidance, I can accomplish that easily. (breaks cookie) Watch. "If something seems fishy, maybe it's a fish!"

Name: Candace
