Dialog: Let me see that. (She snatches Ferb's clipboard) What is this? Number one was write letters to Santa. What, did you start this To-Do list when you were three years old?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, what's this? Pineapple scented serenity lotion with SPF. "Apply and feel instantly serene". (to Linda) Mom! I totally need the serenity lotion!

Name: Future Candace
Dialog: Yes, that's the one you fix later this summer when we go to the museum. It's the one I took back from the future but now it's destroyed.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why you gotta be all like that? I mean, this is serious! I can't even get down to the radio station to pick up the backstage passes and…

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, my gosh! Aren't you the cutest thing ever? (Her eyes turn into hearts) Aw, you're so adorable! I could just eat you up. Not literally, but you know what I mean.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Alright. But! No trampolines, no robots, no rollercoasters, no firework spectaculars, no native dancers, no running of the wildebeests--

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Giggles) Bye, Jeremy! (She hangs up) Ghee! It's perfect! I'll dress up like a cavewoman, and Jeremy and I will be all matchy, and it'll be like we're on a date! (She laughs excitedly, throwing clothes)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aaanyway, as soon as we're done finding this little crocodile, it's straight to Mom with the evidence! (to her brothers) Come on! Move it move it move it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You got it! Assistant/producer/girlfriend at your service! (she puts Perry back in his bed) All right, Perry, stay put. Don't do much. Y'know, like you usually don't do.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) And look! (Runs up) Here are Buford and Baljeet, your sons being bad! (Stretches Ferb's head) They're in disguises! Uh, really good disguises! (Grunts while stretching Phineas' head, chuckles deadpanned) It'll come off in a second.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ping pong, huh? III bet. I'll just stay right here until the inevitable weirdness happens. Aaany minute now. Alright, so where's Perry?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Eee... (Cell phone rings) just one second. [the following phone conversation is between Candace at the Beach and the shocked Linda in the car.] (dreamily, on phone) Hellooooo?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (talking to Stacy on the phone) I think you're right Stacy, the ocean would be a lot deeper without all those sponges. (Candace hears noises outside) What is that noise? It is driving me crazy! Aha!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah, Glosstacular lipstick! Now I can blow up a bounce house and my lips would still be shiny! (She starts to put on lipstick, but Buford zips past her, ruining it and her hair. She smooths it out.) I bet Phineas and Ferb are behind this...

Name: Candace
Dialog: New law: today is "Free Clothing For The Mayor Day"! I'll take that! And I'll take that! And I'll take that! And I'll take that! And...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look, apparently I missed some big musical number with Clay Aiken and Chaka Khan, okay? So can we please stop using it as a reference?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (On the phone) Hi Mom, yeah we're okay. In fact I was just about to call you. I can't see what Phineas and Ferb are making but I'm sure it's bustable.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That makes my head all buzzy. Wait, wait a minute, wait! I'm remembering! Yes, yes, I see it! Over there, through the trees! That's it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, I sent Jeremy a text message twelve minutes ago and he still hasn't answered. You don't think I'm making a big deal out of this?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey Stacy. (Blows out fire) I've got a lot that I want to do today, so I figured I'd bust Phineas and Ferb early. You know, just to get it off my plate.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes! That sounds do-able! Why not pick me up around noon? Okay! Goodbye. (hangs up, dials Stacy) Oh, my gosh! Guess who just called and asked me out on a date!

Name: Candace
Dialog: …and just for a moment, it seemed that the wily Buford would steal away the coveted surfing trophy from under the noses of our heroes…

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, I think I'm getting the hang of this. All I need to do is B.L.A.R.F.: Be Living, Always Really Focused. I focused, and it worked.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! put that down. Suzy that's my 1984 collectable Ducky Momo plate, where they printed the entire design upside down. It's priceless.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, Mom. So, uh, oh, there's this selfie with a selfie thing people are doing online. You take a pic, dress the same as someone else.

Name: Candace's Brain
Dialog: Has it come to this? (looks closer) Just standing out in the yard, (Camera zooms out, showing Phineas and Ferb sitting by the tree) Staring at your brothers, waiting? (Zoom into Phineas and Ferb) They're gonna do something bustable, I know it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, but get this: Every part of their body is a musical instrument, and they never even discovered music before. Martians are so lame.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I got you guys this time! There's no way you could dismantle your stupid tropical dream house before I drag Mom back here to bust you! (She walks out.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Showing Linda) They built a giant machine that does their chores! It shucks the corn, and it shoots seeds out of a Gatling gu-uh...? (She sees that machine is no longer there) But, but, but...

Name: Candace
Dialog: I've got a feeling that today is the day. Even as we speak, my brothers are planning something dangerous, disguised as playing cards!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) I'll tell you why! (walks up) Because...it doesn't matter! You can live a long, happy life without knowing the tip of a shoelace is called a...? (pauses)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whatever. I have got your back, sister. I will stay out of the yard, and keep Mom out of the way too. (Folds her arms) Like, that should be difficult.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (seriously) Yeah, I just have a few notes here. (Excitedly, as she reveals she drew a smiley face on the clipboard.) It's perfect! (gasps) I love it, guys! Iloveitiloveitiloveitiloveitiloveitiloveitiloveitiloveitiloveit...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, well I got a little sidetracked preparing the bust of the century. Later today, I'm gonna show you something you won't believe.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Pfft. Spiders? Are you kidding? Why would I be afraid of an itsy bitsy **SPIDER!?!?!?!** AAAH! AHHH! GET IT! GET IT! EW EW EW EW EW!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dad, is this one of those cultural things again? Because I'm not sure they'd even know what the heck you're talking about in England.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: The robot ants must have been a diversion. (turns on her cell phone) Monogram, we just got ambushed at the picnic. This has Doofenshmirtz written all over it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sure! Ooh, I'll bring roast beef! Jeremy eats roast beef on Phinedays and Saturferbs. (Yelling at Phineas and Ferb who passed by her door) Phineas and Ferb, you're lustin' for a bustin'

Name: Candace
Dialog: I see the building and I still got three minutes! (She reads the directory.) Got it, 38th floor! (She runs to the elevator, but it is out of order) Out of order?! Okay, stairs. Step aerobics, don't fail me now! (She runs up the stairs while the music becomes slower. Whip pan up to Doof and Perry.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh that's perfect. Uh, you know what? My arms are getting really tired, just hold that thought, I'll be right back. (runs off, and returns with a step ladder) You were saying?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't believe my own brother doesn't think I can stick it out. I'll show him. I'm star material here! MAKEUP! (Gretchen hits her with a vaudevillian oversized powderpuff) Let's do this thing!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Good soldier? That's all you think of him? Don't you think he's dreamy, or cool, or even cute? Tell me at least you think he's cute!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, this is quite a jump from group affirmations. How is this contraption supposed to help me resist the urge to bust my brothers?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No phone! Do what I say! Now, I happen to know that Adyson has an archery lesson at noon, and Mrs. Sweetwater will drive her there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Cute little sundress. Cute little sundress. Cute little sundress.  (with the blinging left-sing invisible, the moth van falls into a road hole and the moths fly away and fly around at the dress) Cute little sundress. Cute little sundress. Cute little sundress.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb. Ironically, the coolness they created gave me the energy to bust them for the coolness they created! Hee hee hee! (backs away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: That's what I thought! Phineas and Ferb! I've so got them this time! (She snaps a photo with her phone, but looks at it to see a lot of fists in the air.) I can't send that to Mom! 'Scuse me! Comin' through! One side!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. Kidnapped by flying squirrels and stuck in a web that came out of a monkey's butt. Hm. Well, I guess I have had weirder days.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh? (tears up, sobs) Why it's... (sobs) i-it's...Iiiiit's beauuuutifullll...! (sobs) Mooooom!!! (runs down the stairs) Mom! (trips) I've gotta show you something right now! (drags her) Come on! Follow me!

Name: Candace
Dialog: kids in the backyard, (quickly sitting up) I'm back, baby! (slides down the banister) Woohoo! (lands on the floor and runs past the kitchen table) Tigers at the zoo! Roar-r-roar-roar-roar! Mom, gotta go: errands. (pulls Linda out of her chair) Mwa-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha! (while pulling her out of the house)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Suzy'll be here any second! I hafta get this place in shape! Must! Hide! Anything! Suzy! Can! Use! Against me! (She throws away kitchen knives, the microwave, the blender, and Mr. Miggins in the trash. The doorbell rings. Cut to the front door, Jeremy and his little sister appear. Candace answers it wearing a very heavy protective suit.) Oh, hey! Hi, Jeremy!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, well how can I get this off? Buford is like, the eighth person to order pizza from me. And that's not even how you order pizza.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (outside in the backyard) Oh, yeah. Yeah yeah. This looks good. So how long 'till you're done with this contraption? Think you'll still be out here at four?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dad, can we just get this over with? Jeremy's throwing a romantic summer soiree at sunset tonight. I'm kind of on a deadline here.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ahem. "Beloved Bettys, your band is the biggest, baddest, most bangin' buncha -" Hey, this is my letter. They didn't even read it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Just look at us! We're all fused together! (close up of her) See?! I don't care what kind of freaky project you guys are doing! Just get us unstuck!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Great, great. Make me happy. (She puts Phineas and Ferb's helmets on them and grabs the wrench.) Put on your helmet head systems, use your tools and do what you do best - build a bridge and save us!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, I can't turn around...or stop, but I got it! I wonder if Jeremy's skating here today. Does this helmet make my butt look big?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (She is wearing a helmet) I don't know, Phineas. That door looks pretty solid. Are you gonna try to hack the locking mechanism, or crack the code sequence?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Groans) Okay; just because I need to do things without you, sometimes, doesn't mean I don't like you or don't appreciate your friendship.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, I was brave! (She gasps) I was brave! I'm not gonna let fear rule my life anymore! Now I've gotta go. I've got a mission to accomplish.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, you can say it all you want! (hugs her and does a little dance) There's nothing there! Woo hoo! I did it! I saved the world! (she stops and smiles, pause) You can go back to your movie now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh, score! That awning is the same color as Jeremy's eyes! (snaps the photo) Aaaand... daffodils! Just like the ones he gave me on our third date! (Snaps the flower.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in her room, she’s making a crude birthday card) The boys may have won breakfast, but wait'll Mom sees this homemade birthday card. "Love, the child who loves you most, Candace."

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, Mom, I'm telling you, they're building it, and it's huge! (Ferb puts up a poster. She reads it.) "Phineas and Ferb present the Coolest Coaster Ever now open"? (runs off) Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: How can I bust you if I don't know what you made? (A car horn sounds twice,) (Gasps) Dad's unmistakable, two honk horn signal. They're home! Mom! Dad! You're home!.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm going to fell my way through this. Okay, this feels like, metal. And this is some kind of wooden railing. Ooh, mushy-squishy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know, you really should fix that doorbell. I must've pressed it like 10 times, and all it did was squirt sticky stuff on me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas! This isn't Danville; it's a deserted island! The only things on this island are us, a couple of trees and a big fat ox!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Alright, you know the only time we're allowed to make noise is on Doofens Day. So keep it... (looks and turns around) Are there four of you in this room?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey Perry, I'm gonna get a snack from the vending machine. You want something? Suit yourself. I'm gonna have me some beef jerky! (Presses button; the alarm starts beeping.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I can certainly fake it for long enough to convince your mom. Remember that time I pretended to be Irish for a whole week?

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's pronounced, "Stay away from him!" (The Princess hangs up and Candace gets a dial tone) Hello? Hello? Okay, that tears it! (Takes off the Princess' dress revealing her regular wardrobe underneath) That's enough princess for today! I want my life back! (runs off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: But Rigatoni's work is passionless! With minimal importance! Every piece betrays its own lack of interest in the subject matter!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, Mom, don't leave yet! Li'l Saul and the entire Breakingham Palace Crew are in here! (Knocking on invention) Come on, I know you're in there, Saul!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as if in prayer) Oh, Mysterious Force, if I ever needed you to destroy the boys' inventions, it's now. If you can hear me, please answer my call!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (cont'd) Before I take you through my six-step plan to using this model of our neighborhood, I'd like to go over some pre-busting basics.

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...and once again, just as I was about to show my mom, some Mysterious Force took the Rollercoaster away, foiling my epic bust!

Name: Future Candace
Dialog: Oh honey, don't exaggerate. I wish you would just get along. Your uncles Phineas and Ferb and I were great friends as children.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, they gotta come back sometime, and when they do, I'll be standing right here ready to bust them. (Three seagulls land on her head and shoulders, imitating her on the lookout. She shakes her arms to shoo them away) Would you get off of me?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: If we can get to the north tunnel before they get to us, I can trip the security door. (Perry pulls his collar off his neck) Isabella, can you give us more throttle?

Name: Romantic Candace
Dialog: My Jeremy, my Jeremy, my Jeremy and I will be forever. My Jeremy, Jeremy, Jeremy will leave me never. Ooh, Jeremy. Yay, Jeremy!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, but much better is when Mom sees this. Look at that thing. I'd just like to see you try to get rid of that before Mom ---

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh yeah. Sounds like... (makes phone noise) BRRRRING!! Oh, hey. I got a phone call from, um... a real person. Gotta go. (walks out of backyard, calling Stacy on her phone) Stacy, we have a Code Teal.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in a large-sized cradle) I'll say when it just about does it. Mmm-hmm. Hmm. Hmm. (at the egg) And how's my wugga wuggums? So cute! (at herself) Hmm. Not bad for a couple of boys.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (In a mocking tone) "Hey Ferb, I know what we're going to do today. Let's get ourselves totally busted by crashing our stupid toy in the backyard."

Name: Candace
Dialog: (stops dancing) Hmmm. I don't know! But, Mom, you and Dad have to come to the backyard with me right now and see what the boys are— (Sees the two devices rocketing over the house leaving a puff of smoke in the shape of a heart. She sighs.) Nevermind.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, I mean, a Mom...Attractor. A big contraption that will attract Mom so that she will come home and see what you guys built.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sniffs) (record scratch) Ew! (Perry wakes up) You're not supposed to be here. (Perry chatters) I told Phineas and Ferb to keep you outta my room. (kicks the bedroom door open as she's holding Perry) I'm gonna give them a piece of my mind.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, sorry to have to rush— (gasps) I knew Phineas and Ferb were up to something! (Linda's car horn honks.) Mom's here. (She somersaults out of the car.) Just in time to bust the boys. Mooom?!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: A-ha! I got you now! Ooooh, you are so busted! I can see that you're eating... candy apples. Not something I can bust you for.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (paints her toenails) Seriously Stacy, boys are a mystery. I mean, what do they talk about when they're not around? Do you think they talk about us?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait. You guys let me believe you were really dead?! If we ever get out of here you're going to be so... Hey, what's going on?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, neither do I, but I figure we'll use what you know and what I know and between the two of us we can figure it out right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Exactly! This whole thing is a pointless and stupid celebration of the fact the shoelace tip is called, you know! What's it's!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You mean, for once, you actually are seeing what the boys built? My busting dream has finally come true? Today be-eth the day?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow, I guess now that we're gone, too, Mom and Dad don't even remember having children. Their lives must be so dull and empty.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Don't touch that thing! (running to the inator) That's the machine that started all of...this...So...uh...yeah...you gotta be careful with that thing.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You heard spa day? Because I said, "Hurrah day". Like, "Hurrah, I can't wait to build houses." That's what we're doing, right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Back back back back back! (Shoves the car backwards. She steps around the spot) There's gotta be some kind of sensor in the driveway! (Camera switches to Linda) But where is it? (Camera switches to Candace stepping around the spot) It's gotta be here somewhere! (Ray fires)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (As she talks the robot is jumping behind her causing her to pause a few times) But Mom, they've built a giant...rope jumping robot and it's... Phineas will you turn that thing off? I'm trying to bust you!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not you too, Perry! You can't all be birds! (starts growing feathers) What's happening?!? What is even real?! (looks at her hand) No! (looks at herself) Nooooooo! Caaaaawwwww, caw caw caw!!! (squawks repeatedly)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Enough already! Time is running out and I am not going to blow my big break! Let's look around. Maybe we can find some clues.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why, yes. Do you like it? I thought an Anglophile such as yourself might appreciate the soothing lilt of the Queen's English.

Name: Candace
Dialog: There you are, Mom! Phineas and Ferb have built a giant skateboard obstacle course of doom on top of the house! You have to—!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, I'm in the panic room… Phineas and Ferb… and—And then Phineas and Ferb… and—And robots! (voice becomes squeaky) Invisibility chamber! Elephants!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whatever. Bird calls is a new low for you guys, right below the bookshelf. (leaves) Call me when you have something actually bustable.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I feel like... (She notices the billboard.) Uh... Perry? (She looks and sees more billboards.) Perry? Perry? Oh, my gosh, the boys have created an enormous ad campaign around our pet platypus!

Name: Candace
Dialog: He just broke our date and hung up on me. Oh, it's probably not as bad as I think. Let's see what Quazmo has to say about it. (The headline on the front over of the magazine reads: How To Tell When It's Over. Candace starts whimpering)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! (slaps herself) There are too many distractions around here! Let's just get out in the field. Here, take this big bag of busting basics.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't care if you brought me ice cream from the moon. When Mom sees this spaceship in the yard, you two'll be soooo busted! (Spaceship is accidentally launched by a cow)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hold it right there, busters. (Truck beeping) Before I squeal on you rats, and you know I must, will you please tell me what's going on here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sitting at a table with Stacy) This is so great, being here as an adult. Heh-heh. Not like my brothers. Who are kids. Who are probably building something...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait wait wait wait wait! So you and a bunch of trained observers are gonna be in our yard at exactly four in the P.M. today?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in the food court) Alright, squirts. Here's your cut. I'll see you back here in 2 hours. Now, if you'll excuse me, I'm going to Mr. Slushy Dog.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! You can't get married in the Galapagos. When I was little, you promised I would be your bridesmaid. What about my needs?

Name: Candace
Dialog: So when all the members of the offending team clear the defensive zone at the same time, the delayed offset call is negated.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (walks up to them) I've got you this time. (sits in the rocket) And to make sure this doesn't disappear, I'm going to sit here on the evidence 'till Mom comes back!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh this is just great! I thought you were going to save us, I thought you were supposed to be this perfect Firefighter Girl.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But how did you -- okay, I'm on my way. (goes upstairs, sees the kids) Put that lemonade down! You're not done yet! (In her room) What the -- Mom, you're not in my room!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Your call is very important to us and will be answered in the order received. (to Stacy) We'll still be able to make it to our spa day.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Um...(Clattering) Uh, oh, well, it's my birthday today, and...I...uh...(Clattering) I gotta check something. Back in a flash, 'kay? (Zips off outside; Deeply) Where'd they go?

Name: Candace
Dialog: From Danville Harbor I stab at thee; for busting's sake I spit my last spit at thee! (spits onto the plunger's bell) Unh! (hurls the plunger at the shark's fin, where it sticks) Head for shore, Stacy! We got him! (the ship turns for shore, hauling the shark with it)

Name: Single Future Candace
Dialog: Guys, I need your help. The time machine I arrived in is smashed to pieces. I'm stuck here unless you guys can build me one.

Name: Candace
Dialog: "The CURSE of the Princess MONSTER"?! That is not what I signed up for! Besides, I can't wear this! No one will see my face!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You're right Mom, this is the best. I'm not even going to think about– Mm, you know. I'm not even going to say their names.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Growls, Sighs) Why do I have to endure this suffering while Phineas and Ferb are off who knows where doing who knows-- (Gasps) What are you doing?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I wanted to tell you earlier but then I saw you in front of your hotel, with those kids, and the girl with the ice cream...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, you know when you know someone, and then you see that they have another, like, life away from you and it feels weird?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, what? No! I'm not supposed to nickname myself! You're supposed to come up with it! (starts crying) You don't even care enough to try!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoa, whoa, wait! You're not Stacy! Hey, hey, hey! What is going on? Huh? (Clown pulls out a pie) Uh, wait a minute. Now, don't try anything funny! (Pie splashes in her face)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sobs) Jeremy was supposed to be here fifteen minutes ago, and, clearly, he blew me off. No one in the world has it worse than me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, you've gotta tell me what the last step to achieving success is. The boys' ATV is still here, I still have a chance.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That was awesome! (looks behind her to see nothing there) Huh, I guess they're not doing anything today. (leaves) I am going to the mall and picking up a pleather jumpsuit!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey! Weren't you taller? ... Perry! Quick! Get me out of here before that whatever -inator zaps me. ... Haha! That tickles! (giggles)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy! Did you make a digital sound file of yourself saying "Uh huh" to fool me into thinking you're listening to me again?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ma May Me Mo Mu. Topeka, Kansas. Topeka, Kansas. (Cut to reveal those are the actual words printed in the book.) Man this is the worst book dedication ever. How we doing in there Irving?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, what is it, Buford? (Buford takes out some black socks from the bag to answer Candace's question.) Huh. Uh, Buford, I'm gonna ask you a question and I want you to think very hard before you answer.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (realizing) Totally get the crush thing! You know, I don't quite get the Phineas thing. I mean, you do realize his head is a triangle.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I figured you guys were up to something. The tires, the pipes, I see what those were for, but what was with the pineapple?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Right, as if. (talking to herself) Jeremy won't be here for another couple minutes. That gives me just enough to time to bust Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (present day; moving phone back and forth) Aah! (3x) (Sobbing) Then Dad said my parallel parking needs a little work! (Inhales) It means I'll never get my driver's license! I'm such a loser.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bzzzz! Bzzzzzzz!!! Bzz bzzz bzzzzzz! Bzzzzzz! (close up on fly Candace as she buzzes in her mother's ear) Mom, look! Phineas and Ferb invented somethin' that turns people into flies!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, they are so busted! Alright, you dweebs, what's going on here? (walking into the conveyor belt) I don't have time for this! I've got a huge date and...(yelling)

Name: Candace
Dialog: No!! Er, I mean, no need. (pushing her mom out) Just go and, uh feel free to stay out for a while. Stay out all afternoon in fact. Heh-heh, heh.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ha! Now If I could just find one piece of Ducky Momo merchandise I don't already have, all this would be totally worth it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, I don't care if it's a Ferris wheel to Jupiter or a bionic meatloaf. I'm going to relax. Now go ahead. Run along.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So let me get this straight, after everything they've done this summer, you decide to yell at them for a few dirty towels?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'd love to, but I gotta finish shopping and get back to my brothers who are making some impossible thing in the backyard.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I know, you're way too busy getting us ready for school, so I'll just take care of the stuff I have to do before tomorrow.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Well, keep your heads down! (they duck) Consider yourselves trained. (the Normbots approach) This is gonna be close. (she picks up her staff and twirls it) All right, you rust buckets. Let's dance.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, please! Asking two boys for romantic advice? Now that's just pathetic. Don't you and Mom have any cherished memories?

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Okay, I get it, you're still married. But why would you send the ants to the picnic? You had to know we'd come after you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow! Finding a new best friend is even harder than I thought! Makes me kinda miss Stacy! Why did I let our friendship go?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh... my... gosh! I can't believe it! We're finally going to have our first... (with Stacy) Spa day! Algae infused seaweed mud wrap...

Name: Candace
Dialog: I knew they'd practically bust themselves, if I just waited long enough. You guys are so busted, in like... nine minutes.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, not beef, chicken! Oh, you're the cake guy? (Beep) Oh, hold please. (Click) What? No I don't want to save money on my car insurance.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Quick, what should we do? Hide? No, wait, pretend you're a talent scout. Ooh, here! I think I have a fake mustache on me!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, my gosh. I don't know how you two turned yourselves into babies, but that is sooo bustable! (Holds up her phone) Smile and say, "Hi, Mom!"

Name: Candace
Dialog: This is for the book club Jeremy and I joined. We all read the same book, and then we get together, and discuss over tea.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to her mom) You've gotta believe me! There were these color-changing, voice-copying birds hiding the boys' invention the whole time!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ha ha! That was great. What a dumb coincidence. (breaks another cookie) Let's try another. "You'll know the truth when it hits you." OK, boring.

Name: Candace
Dialog: The moon? Wait a minute, why are you going to the moon? Kind of a step backward considering you've already been to Mars.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I kind of miss the little guys. It's as if there was a whole other side to our relationship that I never noticed before.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Glue gun? What are they up to? Later, Stace. I knew it! I just knew you would be up to something by now. Et tu, Grandpa?

Name: Candace
Dialog: There it is; The world's famous runway of Gaston Le Mode. Oh, Stacy, can you imagine the glamorous life of a supermodel?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, really? Did you hear that, Stacy? The mysterious force took the platypult away before I, the grown up, could see it.

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: All you have to do is look at me! (Doorbell rings) If that's Jeremy, tell him... I'm getting ready. I don't want him to see me like this. (doorbell rings again)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah, ignore them. They're harmless. Hey, why don't you hang out a while so you can tell everyone how popular I've become.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Dad, the boys have a restaurant in the yard, and they're not letting me in. You've gotta put a stop to it! Come on!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! Irving, keep quiet! Wait! That treehouse could be a good vantage point for my step two. Irving, you're on the team!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Candace and Linda's Sandcastle falls over) Err! This is the third time it's fallen! I used to be good at this! Now I'm Frank Lloyd Wrong! When did it get so hard?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Whoa-whoa-whoa wai-wai-wait! By "in charge", does that mean I'm in control of everything around here while you're gone?

Name: Candace
Dialog: So I asked Jeremy if he was going to the festival and he's like "Yeah, are you going to the festival?" and then I go...

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's totally time for a totally favorite TV show! (offering Jeremy a seat when he arrives) Hey, Jeremy. Care to have a seat? Ehehe I have something to show you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (monotone) I dunno, Stacy. With the A/C on the fritz, I don't have the energy to move. I don't even feel like busting my brothers.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, if you talk to Dad, just tell him to meet me at the park. I couldn't find him anywhere, so I came down by myself.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, I guess you're right. And you know what the best part is? I haven't even thought about my brothers the whole day.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I thought I did it right this time! Only I'd stay til the end of that seminar! (realizes) Wait, Stacy's been there all day! (dials phone and laughs chaotically) Stacy!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, there's only one thing I'm saying hello-ha to! Relaxing! And taking a break from trying to bust Phineas and Ferb.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. Jeremy's staying in the hotel La Poubelle. La Poubelle, La Poubelle, La Poubelle... (She sees a woman) Oh, uh pardonnez-moi, madame.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I've learned some skills that...Phineas, you're in the drivers seat, why are you operating with a remote control?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, of course! Nosey the vicious zinc-eating dinosaur. Now it makes perfect sense! Thank you, crazy people I live with!

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Does He Think You're Pretty Enough? Ten Ways You Could Be.. Better." Wow. Ten ways? Thank you Quazmo Magazine. (cell phone rings) Jeremy!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Roger! Target destination activated! Engaging thrusters! (She slides the switches up and all the rockets fire up.) Phineas, it's working! The Earth is moving back into position!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fun?! Are you nuts?! And how did a rollercoaster turn into broccoli?! And why broccoli?! How does that make any sense?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, uh, yeah, a friend needs a paperweight for her, uh, desk, and mmm, this little trinket looks about the right size.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (She and Vanessa are running from the giant snowball while Candace shouts) Start the plane! Start the plane! Start the plane! Start the plane! Start the plane! Start the plane! Start the plane!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sorry, Dad, there's no time for that now. We gotta go while I'm still in the zone. (walking like Klimaploon) Nang nang nang nang nang nang nang.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But... but... but... but... Wait, a minute. I am on vacation, he is working. I pass the bust baton to you, sir! Aloha! (sighs in contentment)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uhh, you don't think he could've argued with someone, at say... 3:38 am, got his feelings hurt, then run away, do you?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (smiles, grabbing her mother) Mom, let's go, let's go, let's go! (Cut to outside) Mom, I've been trying to tell you all summer! They make these amazing things! Look!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Screams) Oh, I had no idea this thing was so high! (Gasps, ties her seatbelt up) There. Great. Here I go. (tries to get off the ski lift but couldn't) Wait! Wait, wait, wait! No, no, no, no-o-o-o-o-o-o!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Okay, but take the Firestorm Girls. It could get hairy. And while you do that, I'll go find out who's behind all this.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) It's true. Ferb told me. It's called rennet, Stacy. (Cut to Candace and Stacy walking in.) They scrape it from the lining of a calf's stomach to make cheese.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb, you are so bus... Oh my gosh! Where'd it go? You there! Small children! Where's the big contraption?

Name: Candace
Dialog: I demand you let me go, you-- You-- Friend of Phineas and Ferb! (Conk drops Candace) When my Mom gets here, you're gonna be in big trouble.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, you and your little Bango-robot better not show up at the convention and make me look bad. (She turns around and steps on a baseball launcher, launching a ball into somebody's window) ...That's strike one.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) So, cool like, you like her "cool"? Like she's totally cool to be around "cool"? Or cool like she's cold and distant?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really, Stacy? Really? (on phone) Gather the press and the media and get them to my house! This time those pests are goin' down! (hangs up)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! The fog is lifting! (enters backyard) Aha! (fog lifts fully; the rodeo is gone.) Uh...rodeo? Bu—bu-bu-bu-but the... there was an... and I saw... a-and the bulls...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh, I'm gonna go tell mom and when she sees what you are doing, you are going down! (runs off) Down, down, down! (Phineas and Ferb look blankly while she walks away.) D-O-W-N, down!

Name: Candace
Dialog: If we're gonna do this, we're gonna do it right! Here, fill these buckets with water, I'm going to go find some sand.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Inside...) Come on, Stacy! We've gotta hurry so we could get a spot in li -- yayaya. (realized the line's too long) I've never sang in front of so many people!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (reveals her hair is messed up) Yeah, you think he'll notice? This is the worst bad hair day ever! I'm officially freaking out! (picks up her cell phone) I'll call and cancel.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (while pushing Captain Squint up the gangplank) Uh-huh, uh-huh. Yeah. Uh-huh. sure. Uh-huh. Uh-huh. (Snores) Uh-huh. Oh, yeah. Uh-huh. Yeah, I know, he sounds like a bad guy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What is this thing? Some sort of souped-up techno-geek camera? I wonder what it... (Candace zaps herself to liquid) Phineas and Ferb! (A bird bathes in Candace's liquid) No! Get off! Ew! (gargles)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, Ferb, Mom put me on noise patrol while she's taking an online test. She needs it to be... (loudly) ABSOLUTELY QUIET!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Look what Phineas and Ferb did to me. I'm fifty feet tall. I don't even fit in.... the... house. (realizing) I'm back to normal.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, look, it's just forced perspective, look! They're not really here! (The real Phineas and Ferb come over.) It's an optical illusion! He's not really --

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, you gotta come home right away. Phineas and Ferb have… th-they build a… a thing that… that… oh, what's the use?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, a non-believer, huh? Well, you know what? I'm gonna get proof. I'm gonna get proof! You'll see. Ferb's an alien!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (chuckles) You betcha! Flipping over wing passes, and then shoulder dorkin' the old jazz hands. It's like some kind of disease!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on you stupid thing, work! (The flashlight turns on) There. Now where is it? (sees a glimpse of mechanical arms) What the -- ? (The flashlight goes out) Ugh, stupid thing. What are you guys building?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Please, even you can't change the law of gravity. It's a universal law, like "You can't wear white after Labor Day".

Name: Candace
Dialog: Anyway, maybe, let's, like, go inside. Or we could just go in through the backyard for no reason. None at all, even.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, Jeremy, I was wondering, uh... if you'd like to go to the Night of the Falling Stars Girls-Choice Dance with me.

Name: Future Candace
Dialog: Wow. Was I always this nuts? (To her past self) Candace, honey, get a hold of yourself. I have no interest in busting the boys anymore.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: The Normbots are in the other dimension? This isn't the time to escape. This is the time to make our move! (she puts on the glasses) Let's go!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, this is so embarrassing. I'm just so glad that Jeremy's on break. If he saw me in this thing, I think I'd plotz.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gotcha! It's a good thing I threw away a lifelong friendship to keep an eye on you two and your ridiculous...uhhh???

Name: Candace
Dialog: If Dad doesn't get here soon, we'll have to— (The Lawrence robot appears.) Oh, nevermind, Mom, he's here! (to the robot) Let's go get checked in for the contest!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Five times the inventions is five times the bust! Nothing could possibly take away all five of these things at once!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fine! I'll just wait till tomorrow. Wait a minute, at midnight it'll be tomorrow. I can just stay up and bust them.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, it's not your father? It's a mug shot? Oh no! Phineas and Ferb have been abducted by an intergalactic criminal!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? Na-Nooo! (Perry chatters) Ew! Gross! Phineas and Ferb! Your smelly rodent pet is germing up the cabinets! Where are those two?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know, after all of this, I'm gonna give myself a little more time to be young. It's not such a bad place to be.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (collecting coconuts) We don't need to eat. We need to get out of here! (tries to get a coconut off a tree) I swear, if I don't get to Jeremy's party— (A monkey appears from behind the bushes and kisses her) Yuck! Monkey cooties! (The monkey grabs her, leading up a ladder of monkeys and flings her into a hut.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Love it! The Booby-hatched trash-nut whatever it is, is my new favorite bird! This is awesome, see you guys later.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's just that I think you're perfect, Jeremy. So I don't understand why you want to make me to feel like I'm not.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, please hold. (to Stacy) Look, I don't want him knowing about the whole spa thing. He'll think all I care about is myself.

Name: Candace
Dialog: But I need your help! Stacy told me that Marcus told her that Jeremy told him that he got the perfect gift for me!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (cell phone rings) Oh, hey, Stacy. I can't talk right now. My brothers and I are reforming Love Händel for a concert in our backyard.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (entering with a comic book) Um, hi. Heh. Would you guys read my fan-fiction? It's a story where Thor and Hulk decide to learn ice skating and—

Name: Candace
Dialog: Cool! I'm gonna fly too! Okay, focus, and-- (Jumps off and falls, She lands with a thud on what appears to be thin air next to her bed. the whole landscape begins to crack and rumble) No! I've broken my mind! Reality's shattering before my eyes! AAAARGH!

Name: Busting Candace
Dialog: No, I mean, they split me in half. Well, not like I'm cut in half, but they've made another me. Hear for yourself.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (arranges herself) And that is what a gorilla looks like when you try to take away its food. Oh! Hi, Jeremy! Are you auditioning too?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wai-wai-wai-wait! It's vanishing already? It's barely nine a.m.! Ugh, whatevs. I've got a hard out at noon anyway.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (coming out the wash) Let me outta here! Just wait 'til I get my hands on those two little... (her phone rings) Jeremy?! Oh, hi, Jeremy! Are you here yet?

Name: Candace
Dialog: What does it matter? We're all doomed anyway. I mean, where are we supposed to find electricity in DINOSAUR LAND?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Absolutely not! You are off grand entrance duty. Just go take care of the flowers, while I order the cake. Got it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: You kids have fun. Really, I wish I could stay and bust you but I have a lunch date with Jeremy down at City Hall.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, and no more worrying about Phineas and Ferb. I mean, if I did half the things they do, I'd get so... busted.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yeah, Jeremy got all his shots and Perry got promoted. But you gotta come back to see what the boys are doing!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Exchanging the various items) Commemorative creamer, clear flugelhorn. Clear Flugelhorn for a baseball stein. Baseball stein for cyclops Santa.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Giant Skiddley Whiffers?!? That is so bustable! And yet, so tempting. And yet, so bustable! And yet, so tempting.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Poor Stacy. My fear of spiders got Stacy bitten. (happily) But saved me! Yes! Looks like it's just you and me now, Rainbow.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Any minute now... (Horn honks. Candace gasps) I can't believe it! Mom's home! (The Invis-inator's ray hits the ride) There's no way she's gonna miss the-- (Notices the ride disappeared. She screams) Phineas, what did you do?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait a second. If you look like that, wha-wha-wha— (cut to reveal Candace's head, which is now more than twice its actual size) I've turned into Bobblehead Candace!!! (runs out) **AAAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!!**

Name: Candace
Dialog: There's a scoop here, and I can smell it! (A fly-ridden hick walks through the saloon doors, carrying a pig) Or they haven't invented deodorant soap yet, but there's still a scoop!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) I would be perfect for that part! I've been practicing it for my drama club all summer! I'm gonna get discovered!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ducky Momo Plushies. Momo Collectible Card Game. Momo the Movie! Oh, the Momo-ness of it all! The sheer Momosity!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Puts down phone.) Ahh, Jeremy. (Presses button on phone to talk to Stacy.) Stacy, I am like so hard to get right now. It's like totally-- (Notices the construction outside her window.) Wait, what in the... Gotta go, Stacy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) Mom thinks I'm imagining the whole thing! (Cut to Candace's bedroom where she is on the phone and holding a glass of water.) And I know Phineas and Ferb are behind this. (She sets the glass down. It begins to shake just like in the movie.) Huh? (Steve's giant eye appears in the window behind her. She runs downstairs.) MOOOOOOOOOOMMMMMMM!!!

Name: Busting Candace
Dialog: Ugh! Well, if I come back and I have a flower in my hair, you tell me. Find Candace, find Mom. Bust, bust, bust.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't believe you guys dragged me all the way over here for this. (Sighs) Well, at least there's hunky guys in skirts.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, this could be the first step on my way to stardom and as my best friend, you'll be famous by association.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I said I'd give them space for a romantic picnic, that is not a romantic picnic. That is Bust Town U.S.A.! (She enters the park.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Sobbing) I'm telling-- (Car honks) Mom! Maybe it's my perfect day after all! Mom! Aunt Tiana, hurry up, you've got to see this thing.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, I know you're super busy and all, but you have just got to see what Phineas and Ferb made. I'm wearing it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow, Gluttony Games is totally bloated with mindless mayhem! And the two girls, they were so brave and fearless!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh? Oh no! Was that the right side or the wrong side? No, wait. The left side was the right side. (gasps) Moss! Orange! (screams; runs off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, that's not fantastic! It, uh, okay, well, I-I admit it's impressive, but it's still bustable! Mooo-oommmm!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) Nope. Just an average hamburger-eating football playin', punchin', gamin' boy. (spits) Boy spit. That's why I did that.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mrs. Garcia-Shapiro! It's me, Candace! Helloooo!? Woahh!!! (Screams and falls off ledge, onto the grass) Guess I deserve this for trying to be one step ahe-- (Screams, as she bumps into a growling caterpillar, which is shown to really be harmless after she runs away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (dreamily) Me, too. We're so gonna get married some day. Did I tell you what we're gonna name our kids? Xavier and Amanda.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I thought Meap was a helpless little creature. Huh, I guess I learned to never judge a book by its cover again.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys are so busted! (echoing) Busted...busted... Now I truly am alone. (Notices a Mars Rover) Hey, it's one of those Mars Rovers. I'm saved!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, as the adult, I decree we are going to the park. Does anyone need to go potty first? (awkward pause. Stacy raises her hand) Fine, make it quick.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait! No, Mom! (gets out of her seat and pushes Linda toward the ladder) The boys! They built a truck stop! On the roof! Seriously, a whole restaurant! Climb up and see!

Name: Future Candace
Dialog: Guys, we've seen how time travel can mess things up big time. So promise me you won't go into the future again.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Of course not! Gosh, that must be so frustrating to have someone not believe you when you're telling the truth!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But—they asked me to pick—and I did—and it worked—and now—it's gone! Where did it go? Where does it always go?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Right now? (into the camera) Hey, all of you out there in Internet Land! Watch closely, because I'm gonna bust Phineas and Ferb. (leaves)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Big, slow, and heavy? That's me! (She ties her shoelaces to the handlebars.) If there's one thing I know how to do... (whacks) it's get to Mom! (whacks) Get through to Mom! (keeps whacking)

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know, Stacy, I'm beginning to think that The Bettys have just been taking advantage of us this whole time!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hee hee! Hee! Hee! Just a few more blocks and I'm gonna bust my brothers for all the stuff that's on this DVD!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay. Here we go. "You choose the path that few others dare travel." Done and done. Come on, Stace! Follow me! (runs ahead)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Everything! Don't you see? All the problems in my life can be solved through concrete knowledge of the future!

Name: Candace
Dialog: First of all, it's not a party, but if it were a party, it would not be their party, it would be **MY** PARTY!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (At phone) No; I said crab puffs! (Beep) Please hold. (Click) Why would I want my cake in a vase? Oh, you're the florist, not the baker.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, yeah, just checking out the situation around here. (At Phineas, covering the phone) Uh, Phineas, do you know what you're going to do today?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy! If I do what Phineas and Ferb are doing I would get busted, and them along with me. A sacrificial bust!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, I'd love to bust you, but if you don't speed up this car wash, I'm going to miss my date with Jeremy!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (On the phone with Stacy) So then Jeremy said--- (The green beam passes by her window disconnecting the call) Urgh! Stacy? Phineas and Ferb! That was important! You guys are so gonna get it!! Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, get back here! What's the point of being queen if you're all alone?! (eating crumbs) Say, these bread crumbs aren't bad!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (While kicking at the Mars Rover) Stupid Rover! You're not going to ignore me too. Take that, you ugly, unmanned exploratory vehicle! And that!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Her cell phone rings.) Hi, Mom. What? You feel a sudden and inexplicable urge to come home? (to Phineas and Ferb) (gasps) It's working! It's functioning properly.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Of course, Mom. Jeremy's in Paris anyway. So... When you say I'm in charge, what exactly do you mean by that?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Would you stop already with the horses? Jeremy! I know what I'm gonna do today! I'm gonna bust my brothers...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hey, hey, hey, hey, hey! I smell noise! Is that what the black pajamas are for? You gonna have a noise party?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Step one is intel. Like does Mrs. Sweetwater's book look like it's been read? We're heading to her house now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: The dry cleaner switched my clothes with some Goth chick! I look like a total freak! Like I'm all outsider-y.

Name: Candace
Dialog: As president of the Healthy Dessert Club, I declare that nothing says low-calorie, non-fat more than gelatin.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I got to get home Stacy. Jeremy's supposed to drop off my MP3 player this afternoon on his way to work.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ah, you like it? It's my lucky charm. It was delivered to me by tranquil, Hawaiian waves. What are you up to?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, you know all those times I've tried to fill you in on the crazy stunts Phineas and Ferb have been up to?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Phineas and Ferb have built outer space in our backyard! (Cut to reveal crudely drawn cardboard cutouts of Phineas and Ferb and the "project". Cut back to Candace to reveal "Linda" is just a dummy.) Nice drill, ladies. I'm-a lovin' teamwork!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow, check this place out. Well, now I know how to find Phineas and Ferb. They'll be where the cool stuff is.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (runs off) Oh, Mom! Don't be silly! You can't go out there until we've uh, uh... (Stammers, pushes Mom to the dishwasher) Unloaded the dishwasher, right! (Chuckles) Right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stay away from me and my friends and my gelatin that I don't want ruined with your ruiny ruinness. Hm. (To Stacy and Jenny) What?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (approaching her mother) Mom! Mom! Giant jukebox! Come on! Come on! (Candace runs outside to see the blimp take the jukebox. Linda follows.) You missed it. Giant jukebox, doppelgänger, everything, all gone.

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's the "Summer Rocks" graduation concert. Jeremy's friend Coltrane is an instructor. (spots Jeremy and Coltrane talking) Look, there they are!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yeah, uh, I've only got a dollar, but uh, I just want the one. You can just tear the other one up, 'kay? (The photographer rips one picture.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, never mind. I'll find it myself. (She turns the corner and sees the hotel) Hey, Hotel Poubelle! It was just around the corner! There he is! Jer -- (She stops when she sees Jeremy talking and having fun with some French kids. She looks depressed before walking away. A mime appears where she was previously standing, letting go of a balloon)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, looks like the operation is in Phase Two and I am gonna make myself scarce. (Stands up) Cadet Flynn is out, peace! (walks away)

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, I really do have two brothers and you guys are really best friends. I can't believe you don't remember!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (grunts) Wait! The video screen! (She looks at the screen) There they are! Doing things! And there's Mom! Not noticing! Mom, Mom, turn around!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, honest, I really wanted to spend the day with you but... (She notices that Jeremy isn't in the booth) But...? But? And we were? Uh... never mind. (Jeremy walks in from behind the booth, thoroughly confused)

Name: Candace
Dialog: But seriously, don't get any thick, nerdy glasses. (Hangs up, hears more noises outside) Ooh, as soon as I get some help, you guys are so busted!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! You and your phone! (takes the phone) I'm turning this thing off! (She does so.) Here. (Gives Mom a pair of binoculars.) You look through these and tell me what you see.

Name: Candace
Dialog: "Unfocused"? What could possibly give her that... (hears motor whirring) Wait, did... did you hear that? Was that Ferb's band-saw?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes, I actually busted Phineas and Ferb! (gasps happily) This is the happiest moment of my life! Woo-hoo! (She acts like an acrobat.) I'm finally free! (Elsewhere in the sky, she hang glides with Stacy and Jeremy, soaring pass a meadow.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Mom, you've gotta come outside! I just drove up in this craaaazy souped up car that the boys invent --

Name: Candace
Dialog: I feel like I've been carrying these buckets all summer. I'll never get to the fair in time to meet Jeremy. (She hears Phineas and Ferb's machine from behind)

Name: Candace
Dialog: "CYL, BFF, S." What does that mean? Let's see. "Candace, You Loser....Bad Friendships Fail...Stacy." Harsh!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You don't have to build anything. Just figure out how to fix it! I'm getting your toolbox. (gets the toolbox out of the Flying Car of the Future Today) See? Your tools!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gah! Phineas, please tell Mom there's, uh, something really cool in the backyard she needs to come and see.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Seriously? You're just tossing slender pieces of wood all day? I'm not upset. I'm just disappointed in you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nothing? Oh right, yours is perfect, and I show up with nothing. Do want me to look like a total monster?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, no, I-I mean, that wasn't really me. I mean...not all of me. I mean...oh, this isn't coming out right!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, that's why books have covers; to judge them. I mean, why did you choose these books from the library?

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: (reading from the flyer) "Lost platypus. Looks like a girl"? Why did you use that picture? I don't want anyone to see me like that!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Pfft! Spiders? Are you kidding? Why would I be afraid of an itsy bitsy SPIDER!??!?! (jumps up to the top shelf) Aah! Ahh! Ew ew ew ew!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, we gotta get Mom up here so she can see what the boys are doing. Keep throwing food out the window! (she leaves)

Name: Candace
Dialog: See? Absolute terror! These little creeps have destroyed our backyard leaving this ugly mess in its place!

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's happening! Ladies and gentlemen, without further ado, I give you... (pulls down curtain to the Rollercoaster fanfare as cheering is heard) what you've all been waiting for!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (in a hoarse voice) In conclusion, may your Fireside Girl experience be a treasured one with memories for a lifetime. The end.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, but just don't get big, thick glasses because then you'd be a nerd, and I couldn't be seen with you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: This is like I'm wearing a cloud of butter. Say, don't princesses need to know a lot of manners and stuff?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, no! No throwing. (Phineas crawls to her phone) We use our... (Phineas licks her phone) Ew! (Phineas throws it and it hits Candace) Ow! (Candace tries again on Ferb) Okay, hold this, Ferb. Now, I'll just... Where's my phone?

Name: Candace
Dialog: That was great! I've been thinking of my brothers all wrong! They're not a nuisance. They're my ticket to-

Name: Candace
Dialog: Maybe if I just go in and apologize one more time they'll forgive me. I have a stomachache, I feel so bad.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I just wish Jeremy was more romantic. You know, like Romeo-and-Juliet romantic, but without all the dying.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, Ferb, you did this! With some kind of, I-I-I don't know and I don't care! You two are so busted!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Of course! It can only be destroyed in the fire from which it was formed. Hold on, volcano! I'm a-comin'!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, yeah, that's perfect! Well, they're coming your way! Quick, look out the window! Do you see any cows?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, Stacy. It's real. These cookies know what's going to happen next! I can use them to bust my brothers!

Name: Candace
Dialog: It's totally fine! Okay, this may be an easy enough trick, but how did you make the whole show disappear?

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, uh, do we have a plan, or are we just gonna go all willy-nilly, and barge into that bad, scary place?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, mom, if you go out into the yard today, and there's nothing there, I'll... I'll clean the bathroom.

Name: Candace
Dialog: The lights are all wrong. Go inside the janitor's closet. (Sergeant goes in the janitor's closet) And...action! (Slams door on him; to the boys) Come on, guys, we can escape now!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You're doing a chore? No way are you getting all the parent points. I've got chores to do, too. Carry on.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Me, a vampire? (Scoffs) Don't be silly, Stacy. It would be cool to have super strength though. And be able to fly.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom? Mom, are you there? Something weird is going on! Not the usual weird! A different, not-normal weird!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) Phineas Phineas Phineas...and Ferb! (she and Stacy run into the frame) You have to help us! We're being chased by monster-sized chinchillas!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: I knew this was a bad idea. Alright, everyone in the cars! (they all hop in, and she pushes) Go, go, go, go, go! Isabella, start the motor!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh...uh...so, Mom, do you have everything for dinner tonight? Maybe you ought to go to the grocery store.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Can you believe that?! She didn't have to- Dad? (puts her hand on the robot) Ouch! Dad, you're burning up! I'll go get you some water. (Runs off.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! Teamwork! I mean, we've got to wait for the signal! Any second now. Come on, girls, give me the code!

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: Ugh! We don't have time to wait for him. We gotta get over to Charlene's. Phineas, Perry, you're with me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to Linda) Well, yeah. They are gonna be auctioning off one of the original Tiny Cowboy bobble heads. (Flicks the Cowboy hat bobble-head) The lefty one.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Figures. I'm the queen of little green nerds. Can you tell them that I just want a little time to myself?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I don't like these optics! I'm still telling Mom! (lifts up her phone to find there's no signal) How do I not have any bars? This is our backyard!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (picks up the egg) It's okay, little guy. Candace is here to protect you! (To the boys) What are you doing to this precious gift of life?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (flying in circles) Stupid... New age... Parenting... Articles... AAAAHH! Get me down from here, I can't control this thing!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Is that a steam-powered chore-doing device?! You are so going to get it! Get back here, you steam punks!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Mimicking Linda) "Why don't you go back home, Candace?" "I'm busy with my bridge game, Candace?" She has no idea! (echo) (Gasps, then looks behind her to see the garage empty. Crickets chirp in the background, She smiles.) Gotcha.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You guys better figure out a way to get us home. 'Cause if we don't get home, I can't bust you for this!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uno momento, por favor. (to Stacy) Look, we'll go "help people" for, like, 15 minutes and then we'll go to the spa.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait a second. Does this mean if we accidentally touch, we'll rip apart the very fabric of the universe?

Name: Busting Candace
Dialog: Forget it! I've only got one thing on my mind, and that's busting you! I'm going to the mall to get Mom.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why aren't they doing anything? I've got a golden opportunity here and I don't wanna blow it! Hehhehh... (waves at Linda)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I am not having fun, and neither will you if I ever get back to the yellow sidewaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaalk!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, good, she's coming home. That's fine. I'm good and fine. (burbles) Reading, reading. (Babbles, which changes into...) Hehehehehehehehehehehe...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I'm sure I can spare one. I know how men are about their meat. "Argh! Me manly man! Me like meat!"

Name: Candace
Dialog: (She gasps) That's it! If I can get on TV then Jeremy will see my star quality and we'll be on the same level again!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (smiles) Mom, that's great, but you gotta see something in the yard. Come on, you gotta see it! Come on, come on!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nah. I see him all the time. This, this is actually the freaky part. (She holds up her arm and fist.) And it's all just been one...big...

Name: Candace
Dialog: You know what, Stacy? I'm tired of the mysterious force pushing me around. I'm gonna show it who's boss! (she heads off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow, it's massive! A humongous boat is the perfect setting for a humongous bust! Hee hee hee! Bust boat!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yes, this will recreate how Mom will be in a Candace suit. To fool the Mysterious Force. Keep up, Stacy!

Name: Bad Future Candace
Dialog: Who the heck is Doofenshmirtz?! (goes to a library) That's odd. I've got to find out what happened in the last twenty years. (activates a hologram projector)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oho, come with me, Mom! I've got a submission, all right! A sub-mission! You will not believe your eyes!

Name: Candace
Dialog: And so continues the inevitability of my mundane existence. (The bees deflate the giant wading pool, squirting water out of it, and soaking Candace) Once again, I'm humiliated by the universe.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Scene opens with the gang in the Sunbeater 3000, most of the group look a bit messed up from the crash.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (turns around) AAAAHHH! (the birds dive-bomb her as she runs away) Birds?! What is happening?!?! (she dodges the birds) That's it! I made it! I... AAAAHHH! (she trips and launches the DVD into the air) Oh no! (seeing a parade of elephants coming down the street) A circus? What the...

Name: Candace
Dialog: There's a cute boy next door, and I don't want you guys scaring him off by acting like complete freaks.

Name: Candace
Dialog: By using Holmesian Deduction, we'll be one step ahead of the boys. We can get Mom and finally show her–

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, what did he call it?... The-the transfer stage arena?... The...mind swap place?... The...the, um...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, test run. Buford, you put on the Mom suit. Stacy, see if the boys have the contraption out there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I forgot how strangely impressive you are at very specific animal sounds. Animal sounds. Animal sounds.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, one of the Rebels just saved my life. He could've escaped, but, instead, he came back to help me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What do you mean "Who cares?" lame-o? That's what this is all about! The name of the shoelace is the...

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? I did? (She gets up to see that she pulled the plug.) Huh, what do you know? I did! (She opens the door and smiles as she sees the snow melting.) Aw, summer. Welcome back! (The inator lands in the backyard and takes the control panel with it.) Yeah. Well, that's to be expected.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Y'know, lemme just call my mom. I told her I'd get those squirrels out of the— (Vanessa leaves) Oh, oh, we're going now. (Candace follows her.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Too antiseptic. Think warm and loving, not cold and clinical! Hugs and kisses, not hard and mechanical!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Did, you get fifty, in one day? Okay then. Now Melissa... (begins drifting onto the high wire) The thing to remember about a high wire is...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Just go do something and get out of my way! (At phone) Huh? Oh no, not you. It's my... (At Phineas and Ferb) Go plan the grand entrance!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (still talking to Stacy via video phone) So anyway, I was like, "You talkin' to me?" and she was like all in my face, and-- Termites! (Screams, Termites buzzing) Holy cow! (Termites eating barn, Screams; Cows mooing; Screams)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas, open the door! (knocks on door) Open the door, open the door. There's angry villagers out here. Open the door!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (as Gary Frank) So, uh, what else do we talk about? Mm, let me think, uh... oh, I know. Anyone here have a girlfriend?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! Stop being related to me! And take all your mirrors, and zebras, and junk and get out of my room!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow! You're right about everything! (runs off) I can't lose! (to Linda) Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom! Mo...(Candace trails off as she opens the driver's side door,... revealing Linda's bad hair-do.) Uh....

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, if you care one iota about me, your family, and your city, you'll come outside with me right now!

Name: Past Candace
Dialog: What?! But you're me! You have to want to bust them, 'cause I'm never gonna stop wanting to bust them!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, no! Don't pick her up! She's evil! Evil! Can't you see? She's out to get me! She did this to me!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, this is so cool! I've dressed like half of these people here for Halloween! So what do we do now?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh. Would you wait? I'm dealing with something that actually matters here. Ugh! The internet crashed!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, I -- I -- (sobbing; A car horn is heard.) It's Mom! The real Mom! And I still have proof! (The Linda robot disappears.) Crud. (gasps) But the launch pad is still there! (runs off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, it's actually a bruise. (chuckles) I slammed it in a drawer. Yeah, I think it's probably gonna fall off soon.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So this is kinda cool. Just regular folks havin' a nice time. And Meap. Meap, what are you doing here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ew, no. But if I'm gonna bust you for this, then I can't let you out of my sight until Mom gets home.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm trying to make a good impression on Jeremy's parents (Suzy peeks around the garage door, and eavesdrops on the conversation) and I can't even keep my feet on the ground!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What better way to look after them than by going along and keeping them out of trouble along the way?

Name: Candace
Dialog: A car? That is so grown up. I mean, hold please? (Presses button on phone to talk to Stacy.) Stacy, Jeremy is asking me out for a ride, in a car!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas. What's taking those boys so long? They were supposed to find fuel ages ago. Later, Isabella.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You have to come to the backyard! (Pushes Linda into the backyard) Phineas and Ferb built a whole aquarium with whales and everything!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I can lift heavy objects and I can levitate and... and I can't see my reflection in the mirror.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) You broke the exhibit?! I'm telling Mom! (Electricity fizzing) What are you doing? (Gasps) You broke the exhibit?! I'm telling Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: And you know every day this summer I've been trying to bust my brothers, and it's just not happening.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Because of a little thing called PARALLEL PARKING! See yesterday, Dad was teaching me how to drive...

Name: Candace
Dialog: I can't, I'm in charge of these guys. I-I've gotta be responsible. I'll see you in a week, boyfriend!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You mean I get a persistence patch? And that makes 50, right? (short beat) There's no Persistence Patch, is there?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no! Mindy can't sit with Jeremy! Gotta stop this, gotta tell Mom! Can't go out looking like this! (The camera pans to a paper bag on the floor. Outside...)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm all hooked up and ready to multitask. First on the list, wash dishes. (She dusts the table while walking. Sidenote: Don't try this at home.) Now where did we leave off?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh! Tatooine. Okay, my busting instincts are telling me that the droids went (points ahead) that way. Now, come on!

Name: Candace
Dialog: All I know is, Phineas and Ferb are behind all this, and if I follow this sidewalk, I will bust them.

Name: Candace
Dialog: He, he, insignificant little detail, insignificant little... Phineas and Ferb! Stacy you're a genius.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No way, I don't want anything that necklace brings me. Goodbye, good riddance, Candace is out, peace!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, no, no, no. Mom left me in charge, and I say you and your little friends are not going anywhere--

Name: Candace
Dialog: What if, uh... What if a wild moose, a whole herd of them, burst into the house and attack everyone?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hello? Oh, hi, Stacy! Mom just went to the store, she left me charge, well, you know, conditionally.

Name: Candace
Dialog: We just helped the Bettys write - Wait a second. Dennis, if you're here, then who's driving the bus?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Down, down, down, I know. But what about BFF's, or slumber parties, or busting your little brothers?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Mumbles happily, then wakes up and gasps) Whoa, trippy! I'm having one of those lucid dreams where I'm aware I'm dreaming so I can control it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You don't fool us! You're just here 'cause you know the treasure of Zachariah Yore's on this planet.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bye, Jeremy. It was nice hanging out with you, too. All day. (giggles) Did you hear that? We hung out all day.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Secondly, I don't like the outdoors, okay? I don't like bugs. Phineas, are you even listening to me?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (high fives Stacy) You and me, baby! Of course, we'd have to learn to shoot a bow and arrow, and build a rope bridge...

Name: Candace
Dialog: No! (Slams door) No, I'm not! (Rushes out back) My perfect cake done! (She unveils the cake to have the strangest assortment of tiers, ranging from fish bones to a chicken cage at the bottom) No! My perfect cake! Mr. Delivery guy, come back! (Candace runs past a window only to come back to see her disheveled appearance) The horror.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, hold your horses. (to Phineas, picking up a pitcher of orange juice) I mean, it's bad enough in our own backyard, but at least that's stationary. (pours orange juice)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom! Mom! Mom! (growls in frustration) I'm gonna need some backup. (Calls Stacy) Hey, Stace. Wanna come over and help me bust my brothers?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (walking outside) Aha! The boys did it again! Big, dangerous, bustable: prime for megabust! (lifting cell phone and dialing a number) I'm calling Mom right now!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Boy, that was a close one. Lucky for them I was there or we'd still be trying to escape that—T. REX!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aren't you being a little overly dramatic? I mean, really, what's the worst thing that could happen?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb are the matter. This day was ruined, and I didn't even get to hang out with Jeremy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: They're around here somewhere. (she sees the bubble) Ooh! Ooh! (laughs crazily) There they are! Headed for the old drawbridge! You're mine! (The jet-pack slams into the back of the car and starts rocketing it forward)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, everyone take off your shoes. I don't want you tracking mud in here, metaphorically speaking.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hi, Mom. Stacy and I are gonna have lunch here at the mall so we'll be hanging out a little longer. (Stacy shows a ferret headband to Candace as she gives Stacy a thumbs up)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from her window) Phineas, do not go anywhere. (walks into Linda's room) The ninja outfits, they're still there! Hurry! Wait till you see this. (drags Linda on her chair with her outside)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (shift downward to her, wandering around; imitating her father) "Oh, Candace, go find us some food." Yeah, like a quart of ice cream is just gonna fall out of the— (The strawberry ice cream from the escape cone lands on her head.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, and she's super cool, foreign accent, snake wrestler, high-diving, natural hottie, Nicolette.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's wrong with you, Perry? Don't you wanna get clean, you dirty little... (Perry kicks her; she lets go of him) Whoops! Where'd he go?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Apropos of nothing, I wonder what Mom is doing. I could just call her, y'know, slowly and casually.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, I told you, we had our helmets on. (To Jeremy) So your cousin Nicolette was trapped on a video game level?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (throwing the camera in the garbage) Yeah, yeah. Candace is crazy, but the monster is safe. (Nosey appears out of the water and smiles at Candace.) Oh, great. Look who finally showed up! (Nosey kisses her.)  Fine.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy!! Jeremy Jeremy Jeremy Jeremy Jeremy!!! You gotta see what the boys built in the backyard!!! (drags him)

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: We were supposed to go out, but things kept getting in the way. I didn't have any time. I was busy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (bursts into the garage) Phineas! There you are! This is all your fault! That machine of yours has made me lighter than air!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, we'll just finish this wall and then we'll still be able to make it to the... (lets go of a ply-board she was holding and then waves) Oh, hi, Jeremy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What!? Get out of the way! Wait! Wait! Wait! Wait! Wait! Did I hear you just bust Phineas and Ferb?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Being cas-u-al, so cas-u-al. No vested interests whatsoever. Time to catch up on my correspondence.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Riding her bike) You can't ban me from Bango-Ru conventions for life. I ban myself! (Looks at Meap) What kind of toy are you anyway?

Name: Young Candace
Dialog: (on video) Okay, that one creepth me out a little bit, but that should be no problem for you, Future Candathe!

Name: Future Candace
Dialog: Mom! You never saw them and you still never see them! It's not fair, it's not fair, it's not fair!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, five-year-old me. Here we go. (She timidly sticks her hand into the box, only hesitating for about a second.) Gotta reach it! (The spider sticks out one of its legs.) A little...bit...further! (She grabs the fuse.) That's it! I got it!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, think! If Jeremy found the perfect gift for me, then I have to find the perfect gift for him!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Same old, same ol' yadda yadda ya bledolbledolbledolbledolbledolbledol. That's been my day so far. (starts lowering herself onto an Inator)

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Monotone; **Instrumental: "****Shimmy Jimmy"**) Let me introduce you boys to (takes out toy) Shimmy Jimmy, (demonstrates its climbing function.) the must-have toy of the century. (hands to Ferb) It's totally awesome.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Stacy, you gotta get over here! I think the Mysterious Force is contacting me through the bathtub!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Those kids are so busted! All I have to do is bring this to Mom. (tries to lift it) Wow, it's heavier than I thought.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I hope there's not gonna be a lot of singing in this thing. (sighs) How much further is this "Bustopolis"?

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, i-i-if you're a fugitive from the Alliance, can't they track your remote signal here to Earth?

Name: Candace
Dialog: No it's not! It's my head! And you're getting crumbs all over-- cru... all over... cru, cru, cru--

Name: Candace
Dialog: Huh? Oh, that is the most adorable thing I've ever seen in my life! You guys made a Bango-Ru doll?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy, I no longer have the desire to bust my brothers. We can take our time. (A lizard hops by. Candace notices it.) Whoa, look at that.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Pushing Linda towards the fence) Come on! Come on! Come on! This time I've got an eyewitness. (gestures toward the house with eyes closed) Go on. Go on. Tell my mom everything!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, by the way, Jeremy's gonna be here soon. Please try not to embarrass me in front of him again.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (She is taking a video of herself with her phone) Hi mom, check me out, I'm flying away in an alien spaceship with Phineas and Ferb! I am so busted!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't know Stacy, I got a bad feeling about this. What am I going to do if it isn't even edible?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Dad, and everyone in Danville will be waiting in Badger Town to see me cross the finish line!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, and not only did we save the world, but I did everything I promised five-year-old me I'd do!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I know. Here's the thing. If we have Darth Vader's socks, what exactly did we give the commander?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Really? Did I ever tell you how much I love you? They're this way! Hurry, hurry! They're in here!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ferb, you're not an alien!...uh, you're about to launch? You guys are so busted, I'm getting Mom! (And off she goes.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: So if there's another me, and another them, then there must also be a Jeremy Johnson here, right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (singsong) I don't know if that's what it iiiis, but if you simply look in the backyard, you'll see iiiiit!!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, bird! You'd better give me my phone or I'm gonna rock you to sleep...with a REAL rock! (rim shot on the cell phone again) Ugh!

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: Oh, you think? You guys better change me back now or I'll... Wait... Jeremy's gonna be here soon!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (to Stacy on the cell phone) Ok, Stace. I'm all set up. Nothing could get in between me and some good old fashioned vitamin D!

Name: Candace
