Dialog: I have to meet Jeremy in the park today, but I can't go unless I get this busting out of my head!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (dusts herself off and shouts in her brother's face) Can't you just be normal for one day?!? All you had to do was make a little lean-to for survival.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Alright, today's book is Smorky the Giant Rabbit's Family Picnic. (rocks back) Heh! I'm a little fidgety. Yes?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Were to see her brothers engaged in some potentially reckless activity,... (gets elbowed) Ow! THAT was childish.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy's mom is hosting a benefit for endangered animals this afternoon, and I wanted a new look!

Name: Candace
Dialog: It used to be. Wait a second. You guys are good with wires and gadgets and stuff. Can you fix it?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Is that all? Pfft. Well enjoy your lame, colorless marathon. I'm heading back. (She starts to leave, then looks back at the screen) Wait, who's that?!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, so you think that Phineas and Ferb are still under that stupid tree in the backyard, right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Lands in the pool) Oh, my gosh. I could've been killed. I'm so glad I had my lucky charm. You totally saved my life.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (she, who has been laboriously fanning herself, immediately stops) No, no, not at all! I mean, isn't that what you said you liked about me? That I don't "overheat"?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, so you think that Phineas and Ferb are still under that stupid tree in the backyard, right?

Name: Candace
Dialog: (on her cell phone) Mom, you've gotta see what Phineas and Ferb made. I don't know what it is, but it looks horrible.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, it's red, see? And there's some red detailing on that collector thing, so it's gotta be it.

Name: Candace
Dialog: …and then I was just about to share a smoothie with Jeremy when a coconut dropped on my head, and

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb, you've gotta open this safe and tell me what's inside!!! It's drivin' me crazy!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Here ya go, Dad. Drink lots of water. (gets out her phone and dials) And where's Mom?! (The head of the robot opens up and Perry grabs the water bottle from the robot's hand and squirts lots of it inside.) She should've been here a long time ago!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I got the fennel pedal all the way to the rutabaga metal! And yes, I know it's a weird sentence.

Name: Candace
Dialog: You eat some pie and then lay down in that old sensory deprivation tank we keep in the basement.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Aha! (gasps) I can't believe it. Everything is still here. There it is! They built an animal translator!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (dragging her mom outside) C'mon! C'mon! You'll never believe it! Phineas and Ferb made the world's biggest banana cream...

Name: Candace
Dialog: How do you only manage to see this one? Why only mine? (walks towards the gate) Wait! Come back! This is so unfair! Wait!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, if they wanna play superhero, then we're gonna play super-villain. Call me The Dangiraffe.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well sir, this is your lucky day! (Clears throat)  "To think, to dream, whether 'tis nobler to love, I know not."

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, listen Stacy, there was this blast, and I was sitting next to Jeremy, and somehow we got--

Name: Busting Candace
Dialog: You know, "blah-blah-blah. Jeremy is so amazing. Hearts, rainbows, and unicorns, blah!" That me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, wait, my kingdom… my Jeremy… it was all so beautiful…! (panics, at Phineas and Ferb) What have you done to my paradise?! (pants)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, nice to meet you, D. D. (giggles; the car horn honks from out front.) Mom and Dad? Back already? This is going to be the bestest day ever! (runs off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, yeah. It's another one of their cool rides. Just get behind us and help us watch it.

Name: Candace-2
Dialog: All right, Doofenshmirtz, what do you know about robotic picnic ants and a fist-full of cyborgs?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Dream! (pause) So none of that really happened. I never actually busted Phineas and Ferb. I am so happy.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, I'm going to prove it to you and bust my brothers at the same time! Where are my brothers?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, let me tell you something kid. It wasn't easy. But the Forest Fire Girls really needed me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ooh, I almost forgot. Perry was in the dream too. He was like a super-secret agent or something.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, if it's still here in the morning, I'm gonna bust you guys. (yawns) Your'e goin' down, down, down. (goes back to bed)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh nothing, just taking the what-kind-of-teenager-are-you-quiz to unlock my true teen identity!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, for me! (throws victory bell upwards) Woo! (kicks it, picks up die) I totally creamed you guys in that game. And now, I'm gonna bust you for it. (Candace runs into the kitchen, die in hands and eyes closed.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm easing my way into the driver's seat. I start with what's familiar then slide into the new.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, you guys are so busted, and I have the evidence right here on my body. (runs off) Woo hoo! Mom! Mom!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Why do they even have parties for two-year-olds? It's not like they're gonna remember anything.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Dreaming) Paris... French girls and... Jeremy... Iguana playing an oboe... (She sits up and calls someone) Stacy? I am freaking out here!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, it's just that I saw you and it was like...it was like my teacher wearing a cowboy hat!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm coming. Just a few more feet. (she opens the door for the Johnson family) Jeremy, and the whole family, welcome to our humble dwelling.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hum. Well, they have the wrong sundress. It's okay, but it is not as great as this. (sees the moths on the dress) **AAAAAH!** (runs inside)

Name: Candace/Perry
Dialog: (takes a pink mirror from a nearby box; screaming) I'm an ugly, smelly platypus!!! I'm a platypus! I'm a platypus! I'm a platypus! I'm a platypus!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Mom, Mom, Mom, Mom! You gotta see something in the kitchen! (grabs her arm and drags her, only to spill her coffee) Come on, come on, come on, come on!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You'll see! Everyone will see! (Cackles maniacally. She dumps the paint on the spot where the ride was, causing the paint to splat on the grass. Candace drops the paint can) I don't understand! I don't understand! (Tries to feel the ride) I just don't understand!

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, Mom! You've gotta see what Phineas and Ferb are doing! They're a building a roller coaster!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, no! I-I mean I've got to put you on hold. (picks up other call) Stacy! Wow, I can't believe you're still there.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No time for dry, witty remarks! Must move! Move, move, move, move move! Move, move, move, move!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (coming out of the car and grabbing her mother again) Mom Mom Mom! Dinosaur! Follow me! Haha, ha, ha, the boys are so busted this—Hey, where'd it go?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Detectives? Perfect! I know what you're going to do today! Track down my little Mary McGuffin.

Name: Candace
Dialog: My gosh! The kids! (to Jeremy) I'm gonna get you a lemonade refill. I'll catch up with you in a bit, okay?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait, what am I doing? (Reveal she is on a forklift.) Stacy, get me off of this thing! I need to see what the boys have done!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Bye, Mom! Yes! You heard her. We can't bug Dad which makes me in charge… by default. (pauses) Carry on.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm double-booked! If you count Stacy, I'm triple-booked! Oh, darn my endlessly giving nature! (Phineas speeds past the door.)

Name: Candace/Jeremy
Dialog: (In unison) This is Candace/Candace, it's Jeremy. Jeremy? Candace? (Both laugh) Okay, you go. Okay, you talk, you talk. (Both laugh)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Good question. (Puts her in the rocking chair) You get to be today's first reader. I'll be right back. Go on, you'll do great. (speeds off)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Nice work, Stace! That last mega-wallow in the Razzleberry Swamp puts us back in second place. (lets go of the vacuum, which attempts to suck the rug right up)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, please, Stacy, I've got everything under control. Let's tackle the Mountain King's dishes!

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, Mom, Stacy and I are this close to kicking leaderboard butt in Ducky Momo's Golden Quest!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You see, Mom?!... (then, upset) Absolutely nothing. Oh, I am thinking some very unladylike things right now.

Name: Candace
Dialog: ...Okay. Where did you get the... (notices Linda and Lawrence) Mom, Dad! Thank goodness. The strangest thing just happened.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (sobs) But it was all right here! Oh, why did I think anyone would believe me?! I was a fool! (sobs again) A fool!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let me get this straight. You are going to allow me to pick what you are going to build today.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What am I going to do? I can't beat Jeremy's grandmother. And I can't let my grandmother lose.

Name: Candace
Dialog: We're gonna have to join the mole people! I'll become their ruler! And you guys my underlings!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Noooo!!! (splashes through fountain and coughs) Stacy, I found 37 cents! Raise the bid! Hello? (her cellphone fizzes out) Oh, stupid non-waterproof cell phones!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Fine! Ok, if that's the way you feel, I'll just get somebody else to help me bust my brothers.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, Mom, you're home, you're home! But, uh, I-I think you should go back to the grocery store.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy? (hangs up) Is this a butt dial? He's out getting food without me! Oh, forget it! (sulks) Worst life ever!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Awesome, thanks! (hangs up) Whew, now all I do is wait. While I sit on top of the crate for safe-keeping.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (cntd.) (Laughs) That is so humiliating! I have to send this to Jeremy, and Jenny, The Track Team, Chicago Joe-

Name: Candace
Dialog: (from the phone) Heather Magazine says I'm... (Cut to her) an emo teen!! An emo teen, Stacy! I don't even know what that is.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Those kids next door are building a fort and I will be annoyed if theirs is better than yours!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy. (A couple seconds later, she slaps herself) Who, me? Oh, yeah! Yeah, I'm a big fan of those, those uh, uh... that red one is cute!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What? You can't give up! No coal means no steam, and no steam means we can't make up the hill!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, Jeremy is taking me roller-skating tonight. And I thought I could use a little practi... (Screams)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, that's easy for you, Phineas! Look at all the things you've done. Summer belongs to you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Not in this life! Sayonara, amigo! (stomps across the runway in anger) I am so telling Mom, and you guys are so busted! (falls into the crowd) I'm okay!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Code red, busters! The condor is on the wing! I want feet on the ground! It's real this time!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb built a really dangerous magic show in the backyard! You've gotta bust them!

Name: Candace
Dialog: What?! Nooooo!!! But it doesn't matter. (tosses camcorder in sink; picks up Linda) I know where the last obstacle is. Hee-hee-hee-hee...

Name: Candace
Dialog: (With her eyes closed) Look, look, look! Okay, tell me you don't see a giant, enormous Ferris wheel in the backyard!

Name: Past Candace
Dialog: A-ha! If you won't show my mom what's going on, I'll show your mom! I'm all the proof I need!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Lovely. Well, I suppose things can't get any worse. (Rain splashing) Oh, look. The world's first bad hair day.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Tow line? Do you mean... thiIIIIIS? (She gets pulled by the jetski but they get seperated) Hey, wait! Why is this happening to me? No more bad luck!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (Gasps) Phineas and Ferb! With technology that's slightly more advanced than what we have today. Mom! (She runs off.)

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, no! When Mom's at her cooking class, I'm in charge. Now, what are you up to out here?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well, we're finished washing the outside of the bus. It nearly killed us, but we're finished!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I knew it was— (Is hit by a newspaper) Blech! "Superhero comes to Danville." Well, they're about to get super-busted!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh no, really it's-it's okay. It's nice to have a little space from him. Oh look, our drinks.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No, no, no! No busting today, Candace. (changes channel) It's just gonna blow up in your face. Taking a me day.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Let's see, in 1933, St. Louis created a monument to Western expansion in America. This thing.
